Since it is a 6-place setting, it gets quite full if a large pot goes in, so I can't put as much in as I expected, but as someone mentioned, it feels like two people are doing the dishes. I am quite satisfied because I can put greasy items in the dishwasher and just wash the rest.

Sentence (English): Good no frills dishwasher.
Comments (English): Good no frills dishwasher. Using this about a month now and happy with the purchase. It cleans well and that's what matters most. It dries very well on the overnight dry setting which is handy. It has a fan that will vent the steam overnight. We don't use a lot of plastic, but what we do run comes out pretty dry. You can silence the audible beeps which I appreciate. For what it is, it's a good dishwasher. But as I mentioned, it's very basic. Almost no adjustment except for some tines that fold down in an unhelpful way. The rack layout is questionable, dishes just never seem to fit quite right - and I mean regular dishes, not odd shaped stuff. I can't seem to fit as much as my old one, but maybe that's why it cleans better. I took the handle off the silverware holder because it gets in the way of inserting silverware. Overall, for the price and cleaning power, I'd still recommend it.

Comments (English): [ Nice dishwasher for a great price ] || ---------------- || After going to other stores to look for a dishwasher replacement, we chose Lowes because of the variety of those on display and encountering a very helpful salesperson. We purchased this over the Labor Day weekend and it was on sale, with an additional 5% off. After narrowing our choices we decided to go with this model of GE. It had everything that was important to us (quiet, stainless steel tub, 3rd rack, multiple wash & drying options, adjustable upper rack, additional cleaning jets under the utensil rack, etc.). I wanted to install the unit myself and save money on the delivery & installation, so I bought the dishwasher in the store and had someone help me load it into my SUV. When I got home, my floor was not level so getting the dishwasher level and aligned with the upper countertop was the most difficult part of an otherwise easy installation. The instructions that come with this dishwasher were clear except for describing which pieces needed to be removed from the shipping packaging. I was able to view a few YouTube videos to double-check that I was not missing any steps. I did not want a model that automatically opened because we run it at night and did not want any bugs or dust to get inside. Check to make sure that if you are looking at a model that has auto-open that there is a way to disable it; many models could not be overridden.- Great price (Labor Day sale)CONs:- The buttons on the top of the unit are sensitive and can accidentally be pushed. (fortunately, the d/w will not start unless the Start button is pushed AND the door has completely closed for 3-5 seconds.- Because of the additional jets under the tray where knives, forks, and spoons are located, the bottom tray is very close to the door when it is closed. I noticed that there was a very light mark on the inside of the door where the bottom tray might hit it. The mark was easily removed, but It is something I will have to keep an eye on moving forward.

Sentence (English): With a family of four, we have a lot of dishes to wash, so after much deliberation, I decided to purchase the LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher.
Comments (English): With a family of four, we have a lot of dishes to wash, so after much deliberation, I decided to purchase the LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher. I'm so happy I made the right choice! I've been recommending it to everyone I know! First, let me start with the pros: Its excellent cleaning power cleans everything from children's dishes to adult dishes. Even greasy pans and soup-stained dishes are cleaned squeakily, leaving no residue behind, which is a huge plus! Its excellent sterilization and drying function also allows you to safely store your child's cups and bottles, ensuring hygienic safety. Its generous capacity means you can wash three meals a day in one go, making it perfect for busy families. The elegant design blends seamlessly with any kitchen decor, which is also a plus. On the downside, it does take up a fair amount of space, which can feel a bit cramped in smaller kitchens. Also, the operating noise is not loud, but if you use it at night, you can hear a little noise, which may be bothersome to those who are sensitive to noise. It takes about 2 hours and 20 minutes for automatic cleaning, so the long operating time can be a disadvantage. Overall, I think a dishwasher is not an option but a necessity in a household with children. The stress of washing dishes every day has been greatly reduced, so I have more time to take care of my children and do housework. I highly recommend LG Dios products because they are reliable products that have all three elements of cleaning power, hygiene, and design! I was skeptical about the cleaning power and the price, but I am satisfied with them and use them every day without any regrets.

For this model, drying capabilities leave a little to be desired on the Auto setting. I do find the 60-min speed cycle provides dryer dishes at the end of the cycle. I find the controls a bit finicky on this model. It takes a second for the power button to respond, and I've often already hit it again thinking I missed it, only for the machine to power down. A more instantaneous feedback haptic or beep would resolve this. I miss the physical power button from the old machine. That being said, I am still very happy with this machine and the value it offers. I would buy it again.

Sentence (English): We bought the appliance in March 2025.
Comments (English): [ Broke after 3 months, awful customer service ] || ---------------- || We bought the appliance in March 2025. It suddenly stopped cleaning the dishes in June—the detergent pod was not dissolving. Dishes on the 2nd rack and top row were completely dirty. No errors in the app. We called customer service multiple times, and they acted on the calls like we didn't know how to load dishes correctly, how to use detergent, etc. They kept suggesting multiple workarounds—try this, try that. Every time I told them the pod was not dissolving, which is a clear sign that the appliance is not working properly. It took us 3 (! ) weeks to get a service person to visit. In the end, we had a service person visit 4 (! ) times. After every visit, we had to wait at least a week for the next one. First visit: He cleaned something in the tubes, said “try again,” and left. Same issue, nothing changed. We called again. A week later: He came back. I told him the pod was not dissolving and the middle spray arm was not rotating. He checked and agreed it wasn't working. He said he needed to order several parts and replace them. Two weeks later: He came back with the parts and replaced them. He tested it but was clearly unsure if it was working properly. He suggested we try a full load and, if it didn't work, call services for an appliance replacement. Of course, it didn't work—same issues. We called Bosch again, and they said a service person had to come AGAIN to confirm the appliance needed replacement, even though he had already been to us 3 times. Another 1.5 weeks later: The service person came again, confirmed it wasn't working, and said he would submit a replacement request. When I asked how fast the replacement would come, he said it would need a lot of approvals. I asked him to expedite. I must say, during these service calls, when I was frustrated with the delays and lack of resolution—50% of the time the service person was RUDE and did not know how to treat the customer properly. In my calls, I explained many times that we had been dealing with these issues for 2.5 months and were not getting the functionality we paid for. I also told them that we had to wash dishes by hand, with my wife being in late pregnancy. Now she's almost at delivery—and we STILL don't have a working dishwasher. Zero customer focus. Awful and unprofessional service that refuses to resolve an issue their appliance caused in a timely manner. I live in a high-rise building with 650 units in downtown San Francisco. And I believe I need to share this feedback with my neighbors when they consider their next appliances.

Sentence (English): With a family of four, we have a lot of dishes to wash, so after much deliberation, I decided to purchase the LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher.
Comments (English): With a family of four, we have a lot of dishes to wash, so after much deliberation, I decided to purchase the LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher. I'm so happy I made the right choice! I've been recommending it to everyone I know! First, let me start with the pros: Its excellent cleaning power cleans everything from children's dishes to adult dishes. Even greasy pans and soup-stained dishes are cleaned squeakily, leaving no residue behind, which is a huge plus! The excellent sterilization and drying function also allows me to store my child's cups and bottles with confidence, ensuring hygienic safety. The generous capacity means I can wash three meals a day in one go, making it perfect for busy families. The elegant design blends seamlessly with my kitchen decor, which is also a plus. On the downside, it does take up a fair amount of space, which can feel a bit cramped in smaller kitchens. Also, the operating noise is not loud, but if you use it at night, you can hear a little noise, which may be bothersome to those who are sensitive to noise. It takes about 2 hours and 20 minutes for automatic cleaning, so the long operating time can be a disadvantage. Overall, I think a dishwasher is not an option but a necessity in a household with children. The stress of washing dishes every day has been greatly reduced, so I have more time to raise children and do housework. I highly recommend LG Dios products because they are reliable products that have all three elements of cleaning power, hygiene, and design! I was hesitant about the cleaning power and the price, but I am satisfied with them and use them every day without any regrets.

Sentence (English): As a family with young children, the amount of dishwashing is heavy, so after much consideration, I decided to get a dishwasher.
Comments (English): As a family with young children, the amount of dishwashing is heavy, so after much consideration, I decided to get a dishwasher. I feel I made the right choice in selecting the LG DIOS Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher! I’m recommending it to everyone around me! First, let me tell you about the pros. The cleaning power is truly outstanding, ensuring that everything from children's dishes to adult tableware is cleaned perfectly. I was very satisfied because even greasy frying pans or dishes with liquid stains are cleaned squeaky clean without leaving any residue. Also, the sterilization and drying function is excellent, so I can safely put my child's cups or bottles in it, giving me peace of mind regarding hygiene. The capacity is also generous, allowing me to wash three meals a day at once, making it ideal for busy families with young children. I am also satisfied that the design is luxurious and blends well with the interior, so it doesn't detract from the kitchen's atmosphere. On the other hand, if I had to point out a downside, it takes up a certain amount of installation space, so it might feel a bit cramped if your kitchen is small. Also, while the operating noise isn't loud, you can hear a slight sound when using it at night, so sensitive people might find it bothersome. It takes about 2 hours and 20 minutes on automatic wash, so the long operating time could be considered a drawback. Overall, I believe a dishwasher is a necessity, not an option, for a household with children. The stress of daily dishwashing has been significantly reduced, giving me more free time for childcare and housework. I highly recommend the LG Dios product because it is a reliable choice that boasts the perfect trifecta of cleaning power, hygiene, and design! I hesitated due to doubts about its cleaning performance and the price, but I am using it every day with complete satisfaction and no regrets.

Sentence (English): I purchased my dishwasher a month ago directly from Home Depot and installed it myself.
Comments (English): [ Easy to install and use. ] || ---------------- || I purchased my dishwasher a month ago directly from Home Depot and installed it myself. It was a straight forward installation, and was a perfect replacement. Easy to figure out how to use (which buttons to push). We have had company over several times this past month, and the dishwasher was able to accommodate and clean a full place setting for eight folks, along with dessert bowls and service set. It is simple to use, but not quite as quiet as I was hoping, and there was some food left on a casserole dish I had placed in the dishwasher; everything else come out sparkling clean. I appreciate the controls being on top of the door, as my 16 month old grandson loves to push buttons, and he cannot access them. Also, the door closes firmly enough the he is not able to pull it open (yet! ).

100만원 이상 구매시 신세계상품권 얼마지급, 150만원 구매시 얼마지급 이런식으로 그냥 깔끔한데,,그런 자잘한(?) 치졸한(?) 참여 조건은 없는데 말이죠, 나중에 보완해도 그냥 안된다고만 하니(사실 조건을 만족하는 선착순은 다 집계되었을지는 모르지만, 8월말까지 이벤트 기간이었으므로 본인들이 선집계해버려서 나중에 수정한거까지는 반영을 안해서 결국은 제외된것도 ,, 그것도 복불복 인가요?!!! 제가 그들이 언제 집계를 하는지까지는 알수도 없는데?! 이벤트가 8월까지면 8월끝나고 집계해야 맞는거 아닌가요?)** 무튼 결론적으로는 가격도 다른 라이브 행사보다도 안착하고, 라이브 방송할때는 실제체감금액 (3만원)상품권 지급받으면 낮은거처럼 홍보는 하고는, 지점에서 하는 이벤트를 굳이 기능도 없는 조건을 달아 이상한 조항으로 혜택받는 구매자들을 축소하고,, 결국 설치도 저렇게 차별?/차이? 가 있었던거 보면 '더베스트지성' 에서의 구매경험은 너무 별로였습니다.이번달에 제습기 및 인덕션등 추가 lg제품 구매할것 들이 있어서 라이브 찾아보고 있는데 '더베스트지성' 라이브는 빼고 보고 있습니다.**여러분들도 아무리 바쁘시더라도 '더베스트지성' 에서 구매했다면 세세한 이벤트 조건 꼼꼼히 확인하셔서 참여하시길 바랍니다.(인지도 못한채 이벤트 제외 대상이 되실수 있어요~) 진짜 네이버스토어도 거의 초창기부터 플러스멤버쉽 가입했을정도로 많이 이용하고, 맥시멀인데 거의 모든것을 온라인으로 사는데, 후기 이렇게 길게 써보긴 처음이네요 ㅎㅎ

First of all, I have no complaints about the LG product itself. However, there are many LG sales agencies (?) selling the same product, such as 'CDS', 'Samjeong', and 'Daemyung', which are LG Electronics authorized stores with different names, so please choose carefully when purchasing. 1. The price is not cheaper than the live service of other branches. 2. The installation quality is different. (Please look at the pictures carefully~). Looking at the pictures, I don't know if this is an integrated service center designated by the headquarters,,. I had to pay an additional fee, so I paid and installed it, but when they explained that they had put transparent tape on the top of the cabinet that goes over the cutting board sterilizer, they said that this was waterproof and that it wouldn't be affected by water since it was outside the machine, so I thought that was the only way to do it structurally, but a few days later, when I saw the installation in the neighboring house (same size, same structure, same model dishwasher, same installation cost, "ordered from another branch"), all the gaps between the pieces had been remodeled to fit the cabinet, and on top of that, waterproof transparent tape was applied (of course, it could be due to the difference in installers), so it felt like I was discriminated against during the installation. There were quite a few materials left over for remodeling the lower cabinet, but I thought that the installer had no choice but to do it like that because it was hot and annoying, or maybe because they are different people, but I felt like I was hit in the back of the head. 3. Adding useless conditions related to the gift certificate issuance event (excluding event). Recently, I moved and almost all of my appliances were LG. Around the same time, I also purchased a refrigerator through a live broadcast at another branch. Since the customer service here was different from that of this branch, I decided to write a review after a month. (I didn't even say anything about the refrigerator because it was handled so cleanly. *Refrigerator purchase -> I didn't even write a review -> I received a Shinsegae gift certificate as a purchase gift via text message. I saw it on Naver and whether it was a live broadcast or a rebroadcast and bought it. I wanted it installed the day after I purchased it, so it was about 70,000 to 100,000 won more expensive than the lowest price I had seen before, but they still gave me a gift certificate after a photo review. I wanted it installed the next day, so considering the wait for a cheaper live broadcast at another branch, I just bought it even though it cost more. I remembered that if you write a photo review, you get a Shinsegae gift certificate on a first-come, first-served basis, and then I remembered that it was first-come, first-served basis. I bought a lot of things I needed after moving, so I couldn't even confirm my purchase, let alone write a review. I was so busy with deliveries and packing that I couldn't even think about it, but I installed this. The very next day, I uploaded a nice photo review of the dishwasher first. A while after I uploaded the review, I received a text message encouraging me to participate in a review event (the text encouraging me to participate in the event asked me to use a "hashtag," so I thought of it as an additional Instagram promotion review event, and a few days after receiving the text, when I had some free time, I checked if it was really an Instagram promotion and tried to participate. In the process of confirming the event with the branch over the phone, I was told that it wasn't an additional Instagram promotion event, but a Shinsegae gift certificate was given out for participating in a photo review after installation by a purchaser in August. The review I wrote after purchasing and installing the product didn't have a hashtag, and Naver Reviews doesn't have a hashtag function, so I thought, "Why are you asking me to do it?" Then I'll just edit the hashtag (I write reviews after watching the live broadcast and installing the product, but in the end, I'll write the review at least 2-3 days later, and depending on the installation time, 2-3 weeks later. It's really hard to remember all those detailed conditions.). The date I first wrote the photo review is included in the first-come-first-served date, but at this point, there is no hashtag at the time of collection. I was told that I would be excluded from receiving Shinsegae gift certificates because of my review, so I argued with them, but they only said that it was unfortunate but there was nothing they could do. What I don't understand is that Naver reviews don't even have a hashtag function, so I think it's a bit unreasonable to create such a condition and exclude me when I wrote the same photo review. August isn't even the end of the event period, and even if I try to fix it now, it's not working. Other branches' live purchase participation events are simple, such as giving a certain amount of Shinsegae gift certificate for purchases over 1 million won, or giving a certain amount for purchases of 1.5 million won, etc., but there are no such small (?) or petty (?) participation conditions, and even if I supplement it later, they just say I can't do it. (Actually, I don't know if all the first-come-first-served reviews that met the conditions were counted, but since the event period was until the end of August, they pre-counted them and didn't reflect the later changes, so I ended up being excluded... Is that a hit or miss situation? I don't even know when they count them? The event If it's until August, shouldn't it be counted after August ends? ) ** Anyway, in conclusion, the price is more stable than other live events, and when broadcasting live, they promote it as if it's cheaper if you receive a gift certificate for the actual amount (30,000 won), and when holding an event at a branch, they attach conditions that don't even have a function and reduce the number of buyers who benefit from strange provisions, and in the end, seeing that there was such discrimination/difference in the installation, my purchasing experience at "The Best Intelligence" was really bad. I'm looking for live streams because I have additional LG products to purchase this month, such as dehumidifiers and induction cooktops, but I'm watching them excluding 'The Best Jisung' streams. **No matter how busy you are, if you purchased from 'The Best Jisung', please carefully check the detailed event conditions and participate. (You may be excluded from the event without even knowing it~) . I've been using Naver Store so much that I've been a Plus Member since the beginning, and I'm a Maximalist and buy almost everything online, but this is the first time I've written such a long review.

거의 lg로 했고 비슷한시기에 다른 지점에서 냉장고 역시 라이브로 구매하면서,, 여기랑 차이가 있는 고객 대처에 비교되서,, 지점마다 고객대처(?)가 차이가 커서 한달 후기에 작성하게 되었네요(냉장고는 모든 처리가 너무 깔끔해서 따로 한말도 없었습니다.*냉장고 구매 -> 후기도 안씀 -> 구매사은품 신세계상품권 문자로 지급됨네이버에서 라이브인지 라이브 재방송인지로 보고 구매했고, 구매한 바로 다음날 설치원해서 그전에 가격 봤던 최저가보다 7~10만원가량 비쌋지만 그래도 포토후기 후 상품권 주고, 바로 다음날 설치원해서 다른지점 더 저렴한라이브 등 기다리는거 생각하면 비용더 지불하더라도 그냥 구매했습니다.포토후기 쓰면 선착순 신세계상품권 지급된다그래서 기억했다가 선착순이란게 생각나서,, 이사하고 필요한 물품 엄청많이 사서 다른건 후기는 커녕 구매확정도 못한 난리통에 몰려오는 택배 및 짐정리에 정신이 없어도,,이거는 설치하고 바로 다음날에 간단하게 식세기만이라도 먼저 포토후기도 좋게 올렸었구요후기 올리고 한~참 뒤에 문자로 후기이벤트 독려 문자가 오더라구요(이벤트 참여독려 문자에'해시태그' 해달라길래, 추가로 인스타홍보 후기 이벤트 하나보다 생각하고, 문자받고 몇일뒤에 여유있을때 인스타홍보인가 맞는지 그래도 확인하고 참여 해보려고 지점이랑 유선상 이벤트 관련 확인하는 과정에서 인스타 추가홍보이벤트 참여가 아니라,, 8월 구매자 설치후 포토후기 참여하고 받는 신세계상품권 지급건 이라길래, 제가 구매설치후 한 후기가 해시태그가 없었고 네이버리뷰는 원래 해시태그 기능이 없는데 굳이 하라는거냐 그럼 추가로 해시태그만 수정으로 넣겠다(후기는 라이브보고 물건설치하고 그다음 쓰는데, 결론적으로는 최소 2~3일뒤부터 설치시기에 따라 2~3주 뒤에 후기를 적을텐데,, 그 세세한 조건까지 다 기억해서 한라는게 참....)처음 포토리뷰쓴 날짜는 선착순 날짜에는 들어가지만 지금 시점에서는 수집당시 해시태그 없다고 후기로 신세계상품권 지급대상에서 제외된다고 해서,, 따졋지만 아쉽지만 어쩔수 없다는 답변만 받았습니다. 저는 이해할수 가 없는게 네이버 후기는 해시태그 기능도 없는데 그런 조항(?) 조건을 만들어 굳이 똑같은 포토후기 작성했는데 제외 시킨다는게 조금 억지스럽다고 생각합니다. 아직 이벤트 기간이 남은 8월이 다지나지도 않았었는데, 지금이라도 수정하겠다 하는것도 안먹히구요~다른지점 라이브 구매참여 이벤트들은 그냥 100만원 이상 구매시 신세계상품권 얼마지급, 150만원 구매시 얼마지급 이런식으로 그냥 깔끔한데,,그런 자잘한(?) 치졸한(?) 참여 조건은 없는데 말이죠, 나중에 보완해도 그냥 안된다고만 하니(사실 조건을 만족하는 선착순은 다 집계되었을지는 모르지만, 8월말까지 이벤트 기간이었으므로 본인들이 선집계해버려서 나중에 수정한거까지는 반영을 안해서 결국은 제외된것도 ,, 그것도 복불복 인가요?!!! 제가 그들이 언제 집계를 하는지까지는 알수도 없는데?! 이벤트가 8월까지면 8월끝나고 집계해야 맞는거 아닌가요?)** 무튼 결론적으로는 가격도 다른 라이브 행사보다도 안착하고, 라이브 방송할때는 실제체감금액 (3만원)상품권 지급받으면 낮은거처럼 홍보는 하고는, 지점에서 하는 이벤트를 굳이 기능도 없는 조건을 달아 이상한 조항으로 혜택받는 구매자들을 축소하고,, 결국 설치도 저렇게 차별?/차이? 가 있었던거 보면 '더베스트지성' 에서의 구매경험은 너무 별로였습니다.이번달에 제습기 및 인덕션등 추가 lg제품 구매할것 들이 있어서 라이브 찾아보고 있는데 '더베스트지성' 라이브는 빼고 보고 있습니다.**여러분들도 아무리 바쁘시더라도 '더베스트지성' 에서 구매했다면 세세한 이벤트 조건 꼼꼼히 확인하셔서 참여하시길 바랍니다.(인지도 못한채 이벤트 제외 대상이 되실수 있어요~) 진짜 네이버스토어도 거의 초창기부터 플러스멤버쉽 가입했을정도로 많이 이용하고, 맥시멀인데 거의 모든것을 온라인으로 사는데, 후기 이렇게 길게 써보긴 처음이네요 ㅎㅎ

Sentence (English): Recently, I moved and almost all of my appliances were LG.
Comments (English): [ This is a one-month review. First of all, I have no complaints about the LG product itself. However, the LG sales agencies (?) that sell the same product are branches with different names, such as 'CDS', 'Samjeong', and 'Daemyung', which are LG Electronics certified stores. ] || ---------------- || This is a short review after using it for a month. First of all, I have no complaints about the LG product itself. However, there are many LG sales agencies (?) selling the same product, such as 'CDS', 'Samjeong', and 'Daemyung', which are LG Electronics authorized stores with different names, so please choose carefully when purchasing. 1. The price is not cheaper than the live service of other branches. 2. The installation quality is different. (Please look at the pictures carefully~). Looking at the pictures, I don't know if this is an integrated service center designated by the headquarters,,. I had to pay an additional fee, so I paid and installed it, but when they explained that they had put transparent tape on the top of the cabinet that goes over the cutting board sterilizer, they said that this was waterproof and that it wouldn't be affected by water since it was outside the machine, so I thought that was the only way to do it structurally, but a few days later, when I saw the installation in the neighboring house (same size, same structure, same model dishwasher, same installation cost, "ordered from another branch"), all the gaps between the pieces had been remodeled to fit the cabinet, and on top of that, waterproof transparent tape was applied (of course, it could be due to the difference in installers), so it felt like I was discriminated against during the installation. There were quite a few materials left over for remodeling the lower cabinet, but I thought that the installer had no choice but to do it like that because it was hot and annoying, or maybe because they are different people, but I felt like I was hit in the back of the head. 3. Adding useless conditions related to the gift certificate issuance event (excluding event). Recently, I moved and almost all of my appliances were LG. Around the same time, I also purchased a refrigerator through a live broadcast at another branch. Since the customer service here was different from that of this branch, I decided to write a review after a month. (I didn't even say anything about the refrigerator because it was handled so cleanly. *Refrigerator purchase -> I didn't even write a review -> I received a Shinsegae gift certificate as a purchase gift via text message. I saw it on Naver and whether it was a live broadcast or a rebroadcast and bought it. I wanted it installed the day after I purchased it, so it was about 70,000 to 100,000 won more expensive than the lowest price I had seen before, but they still gave me a gift certificate after a photo review. I wanted it installed the next day, so considering the wait for a cheaper live broadcast at another branch, I just bought it even though it cost more. I remembered that if you write a photo review, you get a Shinsegae gift certificate on a first-come, first-served basis, and then I remembered that it was first-come, first-served basis. I bought a lot of things I needed after moving, so I couldn't even confirm my purchase, let alone write a review. I was so busy with deliveries and packing that I couldn't even think about it, but I installed this. The very next day, I uploaded a nice photo review of the dishwasher first. A while after I uploaded the review, I received a text message encouraging me to participate in a review event (the text encouraging me to participate in the event asked me to use a "hashtag," so I thought of it as an additional Instagram promotion review event, and a few days after receiving the text, when I had some free time, I checked if it was really an Instagram promotion and tried to participate. In the process of confirming the event with the branch over the phone, I was told that it wasn't an additional Instagram promotion event, but a Shinsegae gift certificate was given out for participating in a photo review after installation by a purchaser in August. The review I wrote after purchasing and installing the product didn't have a hashtag, and Naver Reviews doesn't have a hashtag function, so I thought, "Why are you asking me to do it?" Then I'll just edit the hashtag (I write reviews after watching the live broadcast and installing the product, but in the end, I'll write the review at least 2-3 days later, and depending on the installation time, 2-3 weeks later. It's really hard to remember all those detailed conditions.). The date I first wrote the photo review is included in the first-come-first-served date, but at this point, there is no hashtag at the time of collection. I was told that I would be excluded from receiving Shinsegae gift certificates because of my review, so I argued with them, but they only said that it was unfortunate but there was nothing they could do. What I don't understand is that Naver reviews don't even have a hashtag function, so I think it's a bit unreasonable to create such a condition and exclude me when I wrote the same photo review. August isn't even the end of the event period, and even if I try to fix it now, it's not working. Other branches' live purchase participation events are simple, such as giving a certain amount of Shinsegae gift certificate for purchases over 1 million won, or giving a certain amount for purchases of 1.5 million won, etc., but there are no such small (?) or petty (?) participation conditions, and even if I supplement it later, they just say I can't do it. (Actually, I don't know if all the first-come-first-served reviews that met the conditions were counted, but since the event period was until the end of August, they pre-counted them and didn't reflect the later changes, so I ended up being excluded... Is that a hit or miss situation? I don't even know when they count them? The event If it's until August, shouldn't it be counted after August ends? ) ** Anyway, in conclusion, the price is more stable than other live events, and when broadcasting live, they promote it as if it's cheaper if you receive a gift certificate for the actual amount (30,000 won), and when holding an event at a branch, they attach conditions that don't even have a function and reduce the number of buyers who benefit from strange provisions, and in the end, seeing that there was such discrimination/difference in the installation, my purchasing experience at "The Best Intelligence" was really bad. I'm looking for live streams because I have additional LG products to purchase this month, such as dehumidifiers and induction cooktops, but I'm watching them excluding 'The Best Jisung' streams. **No matter how busy you are, if you purchased from 'The Best Jisung', please carefully check the detailed event conditions and participate. (You may be excluded from the event without even knowing it~) . I've been using Naver Store so much that I've been a Plus Member since the beginning, and I'm a Maximalist and buy almost everything online, but this is the first time I've written such a long review.

거의 lg로 했고 비슷한시기에 다른 지점에서 냉장고 역시 라이브로 구매하면서,, 여기랑 차이가 있는 고객 대처에 비교되서,, 지점마다 고객대처(?)가 차이가 커서 한달 후기에 작성하게 되었네요(냉장고는 모든 처리가 너무 깔끔해서 따로 한말도 없었습니다.*냉장고 구매 -> 후기도 안씀 -> 구매사은품 신세계상품권 문자로 지급됨네이버에서 라이브인지 라이브 재방송인지로 보고 구매했고, 구매한 바로 다음날 설치원해서 그전에 가격 봤던 최저가보다 7~10만원가량 비쌋지만 그래도 포토후기 후 상품권 주고, 바로 다음날 설치원해서 다른지점 더 저렴한라이브 등 기다리는거 생각하면 비용더 지불하더라도 그냥 구매했습니다.포토후기 쓰면 선착순 신세계상품권 지급된다그래서 기억했다가 선착순이란게 생각나서,, 이사하고 필요한 물품 엄청많이 사서 다른건 후기는 커녕 구매확정도 못한 난리통에 몰려오는 택배 및 짐정리에 정신이 없어도,,이거는 설치하고 바로 다음날에 간단하게 식세기만이라도 먼저 포토후기도 좋게 올렸었구요후기 올리고 한~참 뒤에 문자로 후기이벤트 독려 문자가 오더라구요(이벤트 참여독려 문자에'해시태그' 해달라길래, 추가로 인스타홍보 후기 이벤트 하나보다 생각하고, 문자받고 몇일뒤에 여유있을때 인스타홍보인가 맞는지 그래도 확인하고 참여 해보려고 지점이랑 유선상 이벤트 관련 확인하는 과정에서 인스타 추가홍보이벤트 참여가 아니라,, 8월 구매자 설치후 포토후기 참여하고 받는 신세계상품권 지급건 이라길래, 제가 구매설치후 한 후기가 해시태그가 없었고 네이버리뷰는 원래 해시태그 기능이 없는데 굳이 하라는거냐 그럼 추가로 해시태그만 수정으로 넣겠다(후기는 라이브보고 물건설치하고 그다음 쓰는데, 결론적으로는 최소 2~3일뒤부터 설치시기에 따라 2~3주 뒤에 후기를 적을텐데,, 그 세세한 조건까지 다 기억해서 한라는게 참....)처음 포토리뷰쓴 날짜는 선착순 날짜에는 들어가지만 지금 시점에서는 수집당시 해시태그 없다고 후기로 신세계상품권 지급대상에서 제외된다고 해서,, 따졋지만 아쉽지만 어쩔수 없다는 답변만 받았습니다. 저는 이해할수 가 없는게 네이버 후기는 해시태그 기능도 없는데 그런 조항(?) 조건을 만들어 굳이 똑같은 포토후기 작성했는데 제외 시킨다는게 조금 억지스럽다고 생각합니다. 아직 이벤트 기간이 남은 8월이 다지나지도 않았었는데, 지금이라도 수정하겠다 하는것도 안먹히구요~다른지점 라이브 구매참여 이벤트들은 그냥 100만원 이상 구매시 신세계상품권 얼마지급, 150만원 구매시 얼마지급 이런식으로 그냥 깔끔한데,,그런 자잘한(?) 치졸한(?) 참여 조건은 없는데 말이죠, 나중에 보완해도 그냥 안된다고만 하니(사실 조건을 만족하는 선착순은 다 집계되었을지는 모르지만, 8월말까지 이벤트 기간이었으므로 본인들이 선집계해버려서 나중에 수정한거까지는 반영을 안해서 결국은 제외된것도 ,, 그것도 복불복 인가요?!!! 제가 그들이 언제 집계를 하는지까지는 알수도 없는데?! 이벤트가 8월까지면 8월끝나고 집계해야 맞는거 아닌가요?)** 무튼 결론적으로는 가격도 다른 라이브 행사보다도 안착하고, 라이브 방송할때는 실제체감금액 (3만원)상품권 지급받으면 낮은거처럼 홍보는 하고는, 지점에서 하는 이벤트를 굳이 기능도 없는 조건을 달아 이상한 조항으로 혜택받는 구매자들을 축소하고,, 결국 설치도 저렇게 차별?/차이? 가 있었던거 보면 '더베스트지성' 에서의 구매경험은 너무 별로였습니다.이번달에 제습기 및 인덕션등 추가 lg제품 구매할것 들이 있어서 라이브 찾아보고 있는데 '더베스트지성' 라이브는 빼고 보고 있습니다.**여러분들도 아무리 바쁘시더라도 '더베스트지성' 에서 구매했다면 세세한 이벤트 조건 꼼꼼히 확인하셔서 참여하시길 바랍니다.(인지도 못한채 이벤트 제외 대상이 되실수 있어요~) 진짜 네이버스토어도 거의 초창기부터 플러스멤버쉽 가입했을정도로 많이 이용하고, 맥시멀인데 거의 모든것을 온라인으로 사는데, 후기 이렇게 길게 써보긴 처음이네요 ㅎㅎ

I had to pay an additional fee, so I paid and installed it, but when they explained that they had put transparent tape on the top of the cabinet that goes over the cutting board sterilizer, they said that this was waterproof and that it wouldn't be affected by water since it was outside the machine, so I thought that was the only way to do it structurally, but a few days later, when I saw the installation in the neighboring house (same size, same structure, same model dishwasher, same installation cost, "ordered from another branch"), all the gaps between the pieces had been remodeled to fit the cabinet, and on top of that, waterproof transparent tape was applied (of course, it could be due to the difference in installers), so it felt like I was discriminated against during the installation. Adding useless conditions related to the gift certificate issuance event (excluding event). Recently, I moved and almost all of my appliances were LG. Around the same time, I also purchased a refrigerator through a live broadcast at another branch. Since the customer service here was different from that of this branch, I decided to write a review after a month. (I didn't even say anything about the refrigerator because it was handled so cleanly. *Refrigerator purchase -> I didn't even write a review -> I received a Shinsegae gift certificate as a purchase gift via text message. I saw it on Naver and whether it was a live broadcast or a rebroadcast and bought it. I wanted it installed the day after I purchased it, so it was about 70,000 to 100,000 won more expensive than the lowest price I had seen before, but they still gave me a gift certificate after a photo review. I wanted it installed the next day, so considering the wait for a cheaper live broadcast at another branch, I just bought it even though it cost more. I remembered that if you write a photo review, you get a Shinsegae gift certificate on a first-come, first-served basis, and then I remembered that it was first-come, first-served basis. I bought a lot of things I needed after moving, so I couldn't even confirm my purchase, let alone write a review. I was so busy with deliveries and packing that I couldn't even think about it, but I installed this. The very next day, I uploaded a nice photo review of the dishwasher first. A while after I uploaded the review, I received a text message encouraging me to participate in a review event (the text encouraging me to participate in the event asked me to use a "hashtag," so I thought of it as an additional Instagram promotion review event, and a few days after receiving the text, when I had some free time, I checked if it was really an Instagram promotion and tried to participate. In the process of confirming the event with the branch over the phone, I was told that it wasn't an additional Instagram promotion event, but a Shinsegae gift certificate was given out for participating in a photo review after installation by a purchaser in August. The review I wrote after purchasing and installing the product didn't have a hashtag, and Naver Reviews doesn't have a hashtag function, so I thought, "Why are you asking me to do it?" Then I'll just edit the hashtag (I write reviews after watching the live broadcast and installing the product, but in the end, I'll write the review at least 2-3 days later, and depending on the installation time, 2-3 weeks later. It's really hard to remember all those detailed conditions.). The date I first wrote the photo review is included in the first-come-first-served date, but at this point, there is no hashtag at the time of collection. I was told that I would be excluded from receiving Shinsegae gift certificates because of my review, so I argued with them, but they only said that it was unfortunate but there was nothing they could do. What I don't understand is that Naver reviews don't even have a hashtag function, so I think it's a bit unreasonable to create such a condition and exclude me when I wrote the same photo review. August isn't even the end of the event period, and even if I try to fix it now, it's not working. Other branches' live purchase participation events are simple, such as giving a certain amount of Shinsegae gift certificate for purchases over 1 million won, or giving a certain amount for purchases of 1.5 million won, etc., but there are no such small (?) or petty (?) participation conditions, and even if I supplement it later, they just say I can't do it. (Actually, I don't know if all the first-come-first-served reviews that met the conditions were counted, but since the event period was until the end of August, they pre-counted them and didn't reflect the later changes, so I ended up being excluded... Is that a hit or miss situation? I don't even know when they count them? The event If it's until August, shouldn't it be counted after August ends? ) ** Anyway, in conclusion, the price is more stable than other live events, and when broadcasting live, they promote it as if it's cheaper if you receive a gift certificate for the actual amount (30,000 won), and when holding an event at a branch, they attach conditions that don't even have a function and reduce the number of buyers who benefit from strange provisions, and in the end, seeing that there was such discrimination/difference in the installation, my purchasing experience at "The Best Intelligence" was really bad. I'm looking for live streams because I have additional LG products to purchase this month, such as dehumidifiers and induction cooktops, but I'm watching them excluding 'The Best Jisung' streams. **No matter how busy you are, if you purchased from 'The Best Jisung', please carefully check the detailed event conditions and participate. (You may be excluded from the event without even knowing it~) . I've been using Naver Store so much that I've been a Plus Member since the beginning, and I'm a Maximalist and buy almost everything online, but this is the first time I've written such a long review.

Comments (English): [ This is a one-month review. First of all, I have no complaints about the LG product itself. However, the LG sales agencies (?) that sell the same product are branches with different names, such as 'CDS', 'Samjeong', and 'Daemyung', which are LG Electronics certified stores. ] || ---------------- || This is a short review after using it for a month. First of all, I have no complaints about the LG product itself. However, there are many LG sales agencies (?) selling the same product, such as 'CDS', 'Samjeong', and 'Daemyung', which are LG Electronics authorized stores with different names, so please choose carefully when purchasing. 1. The price is not cheaper than the live service of other branches. 2. The installation quality is different. (Please look at the pictures carefully~). Looking at the pictures, I don't know if this is an integrated service center designated by the headquarters,,. I had to pay an additional fee, so I paid and installed it, but when they explained that they had put transparent tape on the top of the cabinet that goes over the cutting board sterilizer, they said that this was waterproof and that it wouldn't be affected by water since it was outside the machine, so I thought that was the only way to do it structurally, but a few days later, when I saw the installation in the neighboring house (same size, same structure, same model dishwasher, same installation cost, "ordered from another branch"), all the gaps between the pieces had been remodeled to fit the cabinet, and on top of that, waterproof transparent tape was applied (of course, it could be due to the difference in installers), so it felt like I was discriminated against during the installation. There were quite a few materials left over for remodeling the lower cabinet, but I thought that the installer had no choice but to do it like that because it was hot and annoying, or maybe because they are different people, but I felt like I was hit in the back of the head. 3. Adding useless conditions related to the gift certificate issuance event (excluding event). Recently, I moved and almost all of my appliances were LG. Around the same time, I also purchased a refrigerator through a live broadcast at another branch. Since the customer service here was different from that of this branch, I decided to write a review after a month. (I didn't even say anything about the refrigerator because it was handled so cleanly. *Refrigerator purchase -> I didn't even write a review -> I received a Shinsegae gift certificate as a purchase gift via text message. I saw it on Naver and whether it was a live broadcast or a rebroadcast and bought it. I wanted it installed the day after I purchased it, so it was about 70,000 to 100,000 won more expensive than the lowest price I had seen before, but they still gave me a gift certificate after a photo review. I wanted it installed the next day, so considering the wait for a cheaper live broadcast at another branch, I just bought it even though it cost more. I remembered that if you write a photo review, you get a Shinsegae gift certificate on a first-come, first-served basis, and then I remembered that it was first-come, first-served basis. I bought a lot of things I needed after moving, so I couldn't even confirm my purchase, let alone write a review. I was so busy with deliveries and packing that I couldn't even think about it, but I installed this. The very next day, I uploaded a nice photo review of the dishwasher first. A while after I uploaded the review, I received a text message encouraging me to participate in a review event (the text encouraging me to participate in the event asked me to use a "hashtag," so I thought of it as an additional Instagram promotion review event, and a few days after receiving the text, when I had some free time, I checked if it was really an Instagram promotion and tried to participate. In the process of confirming the event with the branch over the phone, I was told that it wasn't an additional Instagram promotion event, but a Shinsegae gift certificate was given out for participating in a photo review after installation by a purchaser in August. The review I wrote after purchasing and installing the product didn't have a hashtag, and Naver Reviews doesn't have a hashtag function, so I thought, "Why are you asking me to do it?" Then I'll just edit the hashtag (I write reviews after watching the live broadcast and installing the product, but in the end, I'll write the review at least 2-3 days later, and depending on the installation time, 2-3 weeks later. It's really hard to remember all those detailed conditions.). The date I first wrote the photo review is included in the first-come-first-served date, but at this point, there is no hashtag at the time of collection. I was told that I would be excluded from receiving Shinsegae gift certificates because of my review, so I argued with them, but they only said that it was unfortunate but there was nothing they could do. What I don't understand is that Naver reviews don't even have a hashtag function, so I think it's a bit unreasonable to create such a condition and exclude me when I wrote the same photo review. August isn't even the end of the event period, and even if I try to fix it now, it's not working. Other branches' live purchase participation events are simple, such as giving a certain amount of Shinsegae gift certificate for purchases over 1 million won, or giving a certain amount for purchases of 1.5 million won, etc., but there are no such small (?) or petty (?) participation conditions, and even if I supplement it later, they just say I can't do it. (Actually, I don't know if all the first-come-first-served reviews that met the conditions were counted, but since the event period was until the end of August, they pre-counted them and didn't reflect the later changes, so I ended up being excluded... Is that a hit or miss situation? I don't even know when they count them? The event If it's until August, shouldn't it be counted after August ends? ) ** Anyway, in conclusion, the price is more stable than other live events, and when broadcasting live, they promote it as if it's cheaper if you receive a gift certificate for the actual amount (30,000 won), and when holding an event at a branch, they attach conditions that don't even have a function and reduce the number of buyers who benefit from strange provisions, and in the end, seeing that there was such discrimination/difference in the installation, my purchasing experience at "The Best Intelligence" was really bad. I'm looking for live streams because I have additional LG products to purchase this month, such as dehumidifiers and induction cooktops, but I'm watching them excluding 'The Best Jisung' streams. **No matter how busy you are, if you purchased from 'The Best Jisung', please carefully check the detailed event conditions and participate. (You may be excluded from the event without even knowing it~) . I've been using Naver Store so much that I've been a Plus Member since the beginning, and I'm a Maximalist and buy almost everything online, but this is the first time I've written such a long review.

Adding useless conditions related to the gift certificate issuance event (excluding event). Recently, I moved and almost all of my appliances were LG. Around the same time, I also purchased a refrigerator through a live broadcast at another branch. Since the customer service here was different from that of this branch, I decided to write a review after a month. (I didn't even say anything about the refrigerator because it was handled so cleanly. *Refrigerator purchase -> I didn't even write a review -> I received a Shinsegae gift certificate as a purchase gift via text message. I saw it on Naver and whether it was a live broadcast or a rebroadcast and bought it. I wanted it installed the day after I purchased it, so it was about 70,000 to 100,000 won more expensive than the lowest price I had seen before, but they still gave me a gift certificate after a photo review. I wanted it installed the next day, so considering the wait for a cheaper live broadcast at another branch, I just bought it even though it cost more. I remembered that if you write a photo review, you get a Shinsegae gift certificate on a first-come, first-served basis, and then I remembered that it was first-come, first-served basis. I bought a lot of things I needed after moving, so I couldn't even confirm my purchase, let alone write a review. I was so busy with deliveries and packing that I couldn't even think about it, but I installed this. The very next day, I uploaded a nice photo review of the dishwasher first. A while after I uploaded the review, I received a text message encouraging me to participate in a review event (the text encouraging me to participate in the event asked me to use a "hashtag," so I thought of it as an additional Instagram promotion review event, and a few days after receiving the text, when I had some free time, I checked if it was really an Instagram promotion and tried to participate. In the process of confirming the event with the branch over the phone, I was told that it wasn't an additional Instagram promotion event, but a Shinsegae gift certificate was given out for participating in a photo review after installation by a purchaser in August. The review I wrote after purchasing and installing the product didn't have a hashtag, and Naver Reviews doesn't have a hashtag function, so I thought, "Why are you asking me to do it?" Then I'll just edit the hashtag (I write reviews after watching the live broadcast and installing the product, but in the end, I'll write the review at least 2-3 days later, and depending on the installation time, 2-3 weeks later. It's really hard to remember all those detailed conditions.). The date I first wrote the photo review is included in the first-come-first-served date, but at this point, there is no hashtag at the time of collection. I was told that I would be excluded from receiving Shinsegae gift certificates because of my review, so I argued with them, but they only said that it was unfortunate but there was nothing they could do. What I don't understand is that Naver reviews don't even have a hashtag function, so I think it's a bit unreasonable to create such a condition and exclude me when I wrote the same photo review. August isn't even the end of the event period, and even if I try to fix it now, it's not working. Other branches' live purchase participation events are simple, such as giving a certain amount of Shinsegae gift certificate for purchases over 1 million won, or giving a certain amount for purchases of 1.5 million won, etc., but there are no such small (?) or petty (?) participation conditions, and even if I supplement it later, they just say I can't do it. (Actually, I don't know if all the first-come-first-served reviews that met the conditions were counted, but since the event period was until the end of August, they pre-counted them and didn't reflect the later changes, so I ended up being excluded... Is that a hit or miss situation? I don't even know when they count them? The event If it's until August, shouldn't it be counted after August ends? ) ** Anyway, in conclusion, the price is more stable than other live events, and when broadcasting live, they promote it as if it's cheaper if you receive a gift certificate for the actual amount (30,000 won), and when holding an event at a branch, they attach conditions that don't even have a function and reduce the number of buyers who benefit from strange provisions, and in the end, seeing that there was such discrimination/difference in the installation, my purchasing experience at "The Best Intelligence" was really bad. (You may be excluded from the event without even knowing it~) . I've been using Naver Store so much that I've been a Plus Member since the beginning, and I'm a Maximalist and buy almost everything online, but this is the first time I've written such a long review.

First of all, I have no complaints about the LG product itself. However, there are many LG sales agencies (?) selling the same product, such as 'CDS', 'Samjeong', and 'Daemyung', which are LG Electronics authorized stores with different names, so please choose carefully when purchasing. 1. The price is not cheaper than the live service of other branches. 2. The installation quality is different. (Please look at the pictures carefully~). Looking at the pictures, I don't know if this is an integrated service center designated by the headquarters,,. I had to pay an additional fee, so I paid and installed it, but when they explained that they had put transparent tape on the top of the cabinet that goes over the cutting board sterilizer, they said that this was waterproof and that it wouldn't be affected by water since it was outside the machine, so I thought that was the only way to do it structurally, but a few days later, when I saw the installation in the neighboring house (same size, same structure, same model dishwasher, same installation cost, "ordered from another branch"), all the gaps between the pieces had been remodeled to fit the cabinet, and on top of that, waterproof transparent tape was applied (of course, it could be due to the difference in installers), so it felt like I was discriminated against during the installation. There were quite a few materials left over for remodeling the lower cabinet, but I thought that the installer had no choice but to do it like that because it was hot and annoying, or maybe because they are different people, but I felt like I was hit in the back of the head. 3. Adding useless conditions related to the gift certificate issuance event (excluding event). Recently, I moved and almost all of my appliances were LG. Around the same time, I also purchased a refrigerator through a live broadcast at another branch. Since the customer service here was different from that of this branch, I decided to write a review after a month. (I didn't even say anything about the refrigerator because it was handled so cleanly. *Refrigerator purchase -> I didn't even write a review -> I received a Shinsegae gift certificate as a purchase gift via text message. I saw it on Naver and whether it was a live broadcast or a rebroadcast and bought it. I wanted it installed the day after I purchased it, so it was about 70,000 to 100,000 won more expensive than the lowest price I had seen before, but they still gave me a gift certificate after a photo review. I wanted it installed the next day, so considering the wait for a cheaper live broadcast at another branch, I just bought it even though it cost more. I remembered that if you write a photo review, you get a Shinsegae gift certificate on a first-come, first-served basis, and then I remembered that it was first-come, first-served basis. I bought a lot of things I needed after moving, so I couldn't even confirm my purchase, let alone write a review. I was so busy with deliveries and packing that I couldn't even think about it, but I installed this. The very next day, I uploaded a nice photo review of the dishwasher first. A while after I uploaded the review, I received a text message encouraging me to participate in a review event (the text encouraging me to participate in the event asked me to use a "hashtag," so I thought of it as an additional Instagram promotion review event, and a few days after receiving the text, when I had some free time, I checked if it was really an Instagram promotion and tried to participate. In the process of confirming the event with the branch over the phone, I was told that it wasn't an additional Instagram promotion event, but a Shinsegae gift certificate was given out for participating in a photo review after installation by a purchaser in August. The review I wrote after purchasing and installing the product didn't have a hashtag, and Naver Reviews doesn't have a hashtag function, so I thought, "Why are you asking me to do it?" Then I'll just edit the hashtag (I write reviews after watching the live broadcast and installing the product, but in the end, I'll write the review at least 2-3 days later, and depending on the installation time, 2-3 weeks later. It's really hard to remember all those detailed conditions.). The date I first wrote the photo review is included in the first-come-first-served date, but at this point, there is no hashtag at the time of collection. I was told that I would be excluded from receiving Shinsegae gift certificates because of my review, so I argued with them, but they only said that it was unfortunate but there was nothing they could do. What I don't understand is that Naver reviews don't even have a hashtag function, so I think it's a bit unreasonable to create such a condition and exclude me when I wrote the same photo review. August isn't even the end of the event period, and even if I try to fix it now, it's not working. Other branches' live purchase participation events are simple, such as giving a certain amount of Shinsegae gift certificate for purchases over 1 million won, or giving a certain amount for purchases of 1.5 million won, etc., but there are no such small (?) or petty (?) participation conditions, and even if I supplement it later, they just say I can't do it. (Actually, I don't know if all the first-come-first-served reviews that met the conditions were counted, but since the event period was until the end of August, they pre-counted them and didn't reflect the later changes, so I ended up being excluded... Is that a hit or miss situation? I don't even know when they count them? The event If it's until August, shouldn't it be counted after August ends? ) ** Anyway, in conclusion, the price is more stable than other live events, and when broadcasting live, they promote it as if it's cheaper if you receive a gift certificate for the actual amount (30,000 won), and when holding an event at a branch, they attach conditions that don't even have a function and reduce the number of buyers who benefit from strange provisions, and in the end, seeing that there was such discrimination/difference in the installation, my purchasing experience at "The Best Intelligence" was really bad. I'm looking for live streams because I have additional LG products to purchase this month, such as dehumidifiers and induction cooktops, but I'm watching them excluding 'The Best Jisung' streams. **No matter how busy you are, if you purchased from 'The Best Jisung', please carefully check the detailed event conditions and participate. (You may be excluded from the event without even knowing it~) . I've been using Naver Store so much that I've been a Plus Member since the beginning, and I'm a Maximalist and buy almost everything online, but this is the first time I've written such a long review.

First of all, I have no complaints about the LG product itself. However, there are many LG sales agencies (?) selling the same product, such as 'CDS', 'Samjeong', and 'Daemyung', which are LG Electronics authorized stores with different names, so please choose carefully when purchasing. 1. The price is not cheaper than the live service of other branches. 2. The installation quality is different. (Please look at the pictures carefully~). Looking at the pictures, I don't know if this is an integrated service center designated by the headquarters,,. I had to pay an additional fee, so I paid and installed it, but when they explained that they had put transparent tape on the top of the cabinet that goes over the cutting board sterilizer, they said that this was waterproof and that it wouldn't be affected by water since it was outside the machine, so I thought that was the only way to do it structurally, but a few days later, when I saw the installation in the neighboring house (same size, same structure, same model dishwasher, same installation cost, "ordered from another branch"), all the gaps between the pieces had been remodeled to fit the cabinet, and on top of that, waterproof transparent tape was applied (of course, it could be due to the difference in installers), so it felt like I was discriminated against during the installation. There were quite a few materials left over for remodeling the lower cabinet, but I thought that the installer had no choice but to do it like that because it was hot and annoying, or maybe because they are different people, but I felt like I was hit in the back of the head. 3. Adding useless conditions related to the gift certificate issuance event (excluding event). Recently, I moved and almost all of my appliances were LG. Around the same time, I also purchased a refrigerator through a live broadcast at another branch. Since the customer service here was different from that of this branch, I decided to write a review after a month. (I didn't even say anything about the refrigerator because it was handled so cleanly. *Refrigerator purchase -> I didn't even write a review -> I received a Shinsegae gift certificate as a purchase gift via text message. I saw it on Naver and whether it was a live broadcast or a rebroadcast and bought it. I wanted it installed the day after I purchased it, so it was about 70,000 to 100,000 won more expensive than the lowest price I had seen before, but they still gave me a gift certificate after a photo review. I wanted it installed the next day, so considering the wait for a cheaper live broadcast at another branch, I just bought it even though it cost more. I remembered that if you write a photo review, you get a Shinsegae gift certificate on a first-come, first-served basis, and then I remembered that it was first-come, first-served basis. I bought a lot of things I needed after moving, so I couldn't even confirm my purchase, let alone write a review. I was so busy with deliveries and packing that I couldn't even think about it, but I installed this. The very next day, I uploaded a nice photo review of the dishwasher first. A while after I uploaded the review, I received a text message encouraging me to participate in a review event (the text encouraging me to participate in the event asked me to use a "hashtag," so I thought of it as an additional Instagram promotion review event, and a few days after receiving the text, when I had some free time, I checked if it was really an Instagram promotion and tried to participate. In the process of confirming the event with the branch over the phone, I was told that it wasn't an additional Instagram promotion event, but a Shinsegae gift certificate was given out for participating in a photo review after installation by a purchaser in August. The review I wrote after purchasing and installing the product didn't have a hashtag, and Naver Reviews doesn't have a hashtag function, so I thought, "Why are you asking me to do it?" Then I'll just edit the hashtag (I write reviews after watching the live broadcast and installing the product, but in the end, I'll write the review at least 2-3 days later, and depending on the installation time, 2-3 weeks later. It's really hard to remember all those detailed conditions.). The date I first wrote the photo review is included in the first-come-first-served date, but at this point, there is no hashtag at the time of collection. I was told that I would be excluded from receiving Shinsegae gift certificates because of my review, so I argued with them, but they only said that it was unfortunate but there was nothing they could do. What I don't understand is that Naver reviews don't even have a hashtag function, so I think it's a bit unreasonable to create such a condition and exclude me when I wrote the same photo review. August isn't even the end of the event period, and even if I try to fix it now, it's not working. Other branches' live purchase participation events are simple, such as giving a certain amount of Shinsegae gift certificate for purchases over 1 million won, or giving a certain amount for purchases of 1.5 million won, etc., but there are no such small (?) or petty (?) participation conditions, and even if I supplement it later, they just say I can't do it. (Actually, I don't know if all the first-come-first-served reviews that met the conditions were counted, but since the event period was until the end of August, they pre-counted them and didn't reflect the later changes, so I ended up being excluded... Is that a hit or miss situation? I don't even know when they count them? The event If it's until August, shouldn't it be counted after August ends? ) ** Anyway, in conclusion, the price is more stable than other live events, and when broadcasting live, they promote it as if it's cheaper if you receive a gift certificate for the actual amount (30,000 won), and when holding an event at a branch, they attach conditions that don't even have a function and reduce the number of buyers who benefit from strange provisions, and in the end, seeing that there was such discrimination/difference in the installation, my purchasing experience at "The Best Intelligence" was really bad. I'm looking for live streams because I have additional LG products to purchase this month, such as dehumidifiers and induction cooktops, but I'm watching them excluding 'The Best Jisung' streams. **No matter how busy you are, if you purchased from 'The Best Jisung', please carefully check the detailed event conditions and participate. (You may be excluded from the event without even knowing it~) . I've been using Naver Store so much that I've been a Plus Member since the beginning, and I'm a Maximalist and buy almost everything online, but this is the first time I've written such a long review.

해시태그만 수정으로 넣겠다(후기는 라이브보고 물건설치하고 그다음 쓰는데, 결론적으로는 최소 2~3일뒤부터 설치시기에 따라 2~3주 뒤에 후기를 적을텐데,, 그 세세한 조건까지 다 기억해서 한라는게 참....)처음 포토리뷰쓴 날짜는 선착순 날짜에는 들어가지만 지금 시점에서는 수집당시 해시태그 없다고 후기로 신세계상품권 지급대상에서 제외된다고 해서,, 따졋지만 아쉽지만 어쩔수 없다는 답변만 받았습니다. 저는 이해할수 가 없는게 네이버 후기는 해시태그 기능도 없는데 그런 조항(?) 조건을 만들어 굳이 똑같은 포토후기 작성했는데 제외 시킨다는게 조금 억지스럽다고 생각합니다. 아직 이벤트 기간이 남은 8월이 다지나지도 않았었는데, 지금이라도 수정하겠다 하는것도 안먹히구요~다른지점 라이브 구매참여 이벤트들은 그냥 100만원 이상 구매시 신세계상품권 얼마지급, 150만원 구매시 얼마지급 이런식으로 그냥 깔끔한데,,그런 자잘한(?) 치졸한(?) 참여 조건은 없는데 말이죠, 나중에 보완해도 그냥 안된다고만 하니(사실 조건을 만족하는 선착순은 다 집계되었을지는 모르지만, 8월말까지 이벤트 기간이었으므로 본인들이 선집계해버려서 나중에 수정한거까지는 반영을 안해서 결국은 Sentence (English): I am Not happy with the reliability of this product.
Comments (English): [ Not designed for the long term ] || ---------------- || I am Not happy with the reliability of this product. Roller wheels continue to fall off the lower rack. I have replaced a lower spray arm. Now after a 18 month period this dishwasher started leaking bad from the bottom of the door. I had an appliance repair company come look at it and they found that the door seal at the bottom of the door was torn and warped. This was due to a design mismatch of the tub and door, deforming the seal. The seal is non serviceable and requires a complete new door assembly. I would assume the GE engineering team knew of a design problem as they released a new part number offering as a replacement. It may be an improvement, but maybe not. Poor design and material choice from GE. Product is not built to last even to a 5 year mark in my opinion. I chose this product because my daughter had one recently installed and I liked the look and how quiet it was, BIG MISTAKE. GE customer relations would assist with selling the part to me at 50% cost, plus tax and shipping. All in, this is going to cost me 1/3rd of the retail price of the dishwasher because of a cheap lower door seal that is not serviceable. Thinking of scrapping this machine and going back to the brand that served me 15 + years with only replacing a tub seal.

With its ample space, powerful cleaning power, and thorough drying, it will undoubtedly become the most reliable appliance in my kitchen.

I've heard a lot of people say it's convenient to have, but I never really felt the need for it. But now that I've installed it, I'm so satisfied. I debated whether to buy or subscribe, but usually the after-sales service for products is only up to 2 years, but with the subscription, I got 6 years of free after-sales service, so I decided to subscribe without hesitation! Unlike regular home appliances, since it's a product that uses water, the after-sales service period is really attractive. I also have a subscription to a public hearing, so I can use it more cheaply by getting a combined discount.

Sentence (English): I am in love with the new KitchenAid 360 Max Jets Third Rack Dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Best Dishwasher to Date ] || ---------------- || I am in love with the new KitchenAid 360 Max Jets Third Rack Dishwasher. Our old dishwasher would never get the dishes completely clean and it smelled musty and moldy. It was time for an upgrade and I am so thankful that we were upgraded to this gem of a dishwasher. Let me start by saying how sleek it looks from the outside. The exterior handle makes it easy to open and close. Plus, the buttons on the top are easy to use but out of sight of little fingers that may want to test the options out haha. The inside is even better. The three rack system allows for more space to wash dishes, plus adds a tier of organization that pleases the heart. The top rack is great for larger utensils or cooking tools. I love that both the middle and bottom racks have hook options for adjusting rows and for securing more fragile items, like wine glasses. The jets actually surround the entire system. There are jets under every rack, and around them as well. It is extremely well thought out and I know I will never have to worry about my dishes being left dirty after a washing. There is enough room to hold our entire family's day worth of dishes and then some. The noise level is very quiet in my opinion. You can hear it running if there isn't any other background noise going on, but otherwise it would be drowned out by everything else. The run cycle for an average wash is about what you would expect. But I'd rather it take its time getting the dishes clean than running quickly and them still being dirty. Overall, this is the best dishwasher I have ever owned and I look forward to continuing to use it for my family for years to come.

With a six-person dishwasher, I had to run the dishwasher two or three times a day, making it difficult to quickly get the dishes done. So, I ended up buying a larger dishwasher. I was extremely stressed about the dishwashing, and since I was on a first-class rebate program, I thought, "Wow!" and started searching various websites. Other brands were also having sales around the same time, and the price difference was about 200,000 won (the other brand was more expensive). I figured the cleaning power would be about the same. I also wanted an automatic door opener and a hot air dryer. Since it's a modern 14-person dishwasher, I wanted to try out the AI feature. I considered many factors, but this one just looked the prettiest. It's always clean and beautiful. My sink is dark, so I was worried it wouldn't match, but now I'm proud of it! My kitchen looks brighter. Washing is good, but drying seems to not be on the default setting. When I first used it, I made a mistake and it didn't dry at all, so I was like, "What is this! It's dripping!" When I added the standard + hot air drying and ran it, it dried completely. Sentence (English): I'm a "mom who's always busy, even with two bodies, and desperately needs a body double."
Comments (English): [ It's the best ] || ---------------- || I'm a "mom who's always busy, even with two bodies, and desperately needs a body double." When we first got married, my husband and I both worked, so we only had breakfast and dinner together. We could easily wash dishes for two in under 10 minutes, so we didn't really need a dishwasher. No matter how good the dishwasher was, I felt that washing dishes for two by hand was much more time-efficient. Then, when my family, in-laws, or friends would occasionally visit, and the amount of dishes would increase significantly, I'd think, "Wow, a dishwasher would be convenient in times like these." But then, thinking that there were only a few days a year when we'd wash that many dishes, we put off buying a dishwasher. But with babies born one after another, we were always making baby food, and while I was on parental leave, I realized it was exhausting, both physically and time-wise, to wash dishes multiple times a day—from my husband and I, who were now three, to snacks and dishes from my first baby. Then, we moved, and while remodeling our home and buying new appliances and furniture, the first thing I did was research a dishwasher. Since I tend to buy all my appliances from LG, I searched for LG dishwashers, too. Considering I'd use more dishes in the future than the 12-person model, I chose the 14-person model. I liked its generous capacity, which allowed me to hold more dishes than the 12-person model. I also looked for models with 100-degree True Steam, an automatic door opening, handles, and decorations, and a fully collapsible basket. The DUE5BGL1E model was perfect. Above all, The Best Intelligence, an official LG Electronics authorized dealer on 11st, felt trustworthy, and the discounts were higher than other sites, so I made the purchase without hesitation. After installing and using it on September 15th, I'm amazed at how convenient it is. Contrary to my concerns about whether it would clean every nook and cranny of food stains and grease, this dishwasher washes even better than when I wash by hand. After the dishes are thoroughly cleaned, the LG ThinQ app, which is linked to my phone, notifies me when the dishwasher is done, and I just go to the kitchen and put the dishes away through the automatically opened door. It's incredibly convenient! I save time for washing dishes, which allows me to spend more time with my baby, and since I don't have to stand for long hours doing dishes, my back doesn't hurt anymore. The dishwasher really shines on days when I've had fatty meats for dinner. When I wash dishes by hand, I tend to run hot water on high, pump the dishwashing liquid several times, and just wash until they're clean and squeaky clean. So, I usually spend about 30 minutes just doing the dishes. But after eating a huge meal of boiled pork belly with my husband and cleaning up, I put all the oily dishes, pots, cups, and kitchen utensils in the dishwasher and put the baby to bed. When I came back, the dishes were as clean as new, so my husband and I both gave them a thumbs up. If there are people who are washing dishes by hand like I did in the past, I highly recommend trying a dishwasher. Once you try it, you'll never wash dishes by hand again. This is a review from a happy mom of three who feels like she's using the magic of self-cloning thanks to the LG dishwasher. #LGDishwasher #LifeLeisure #DUE5BGL1E

Sentence (English): We purchased our Bosch in August 2025.
Comments (English): [ Not what I expected. ] || ---------------- || We purchased our Bosch in August 2025. But as we are small family of two, it took a while to start using it. My unhappiness with the machine is all the things we were not told, either on the Bosch website or buy the dealer themselves. 1. It is a condensate dishwasher meaning the walls of the dishwasher do not dry ever. even though the dishes get dry. In order to dry the walls of the dishwasher and have mold grow in it she told me to to leave it standing open. May I say trip hazard? So in order to get it to stand open because it's new in the door is really good, The service center said I had to put a dish towel in the door. WHAT! So now I am having to leave the door standing open. Exactly what every upscale kitchen would love to have. 2. Our family uses mostly bowls, and I actually want my pots and pans to be in my dishwasher, however the tightness of the configuration and the extreme angles in ALL the pins, top and bottom, prevent secure, loading of the bowls or pans. However, You can fit 28 plates if they are incredibly flat and if the pins stayed upright. For mine 3 of the 4 the configurable pens on the bottom and middle rack will not stay vertical. I asked Customer Service if they could replace the second the bottom and middle rack and they said only if a service man coming out to verify they're not working. Now I'm waiting for a service man. 3. I asked if there was another rack I could purchase with different configuration for the bottom to fit my bowls and pans and they said no. Yet I believe one of their lower quality dishwashers does have that feature. 4. Finally, we were not told that the optimal ability for the machine to try is if the chemicals in jet dry are added to the water. I am experiencing no water spots on my glasses without the jet dry. As I do not desire to leave any chemicals on my dishes. Extreme use of these products in the past and I was a jet dry user exclusively left a iridescent buildup on all my dishware overtime. I purchased new dishware and stopped using jet dry, in my old Machine, I had no iridescent buildup at all on the new dishes. According to Customer Service, the dishwasher does not work properly unless this chemical is added to the washer. Yet Customer Service said it would only reduce the amount of water left in the dishwasher. But that they did engineer it to not work properly without that chemical. Yet I've had no water spots on the glasses. I hope this review helps both the Bosch company in training their sales people and adjusting their website to be honest about their product. I feel that this dishwasher is perfect for a family who uses lots of plates and hand washes there pots and pans and larger items or for it use in commercial applications. I am sorry that we bought this because of its Consumer Reports excellent rating.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher replaced a Bosch 500 series machine that we bought about 11 years ago.
Comments (English): [ Good, but in some ways a step backward ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher replaced a Bosch 500 series machine that we bought about 11 years ago. The new machine is quiet and cleans well, but I have a some complaints about it. (1) There is absolutely NO documentation for some of the controls and features. NO explanation for what the different cycles do. NO explanation for why the cycle that took 2-1/2 hours in the earlier model now takes 3-1/2 hours. No explanation for some of the buttons. NO description for the multiple steps needed to do a reset. (2) The WiFi feature is anti-productive. The control panel should have been designed so that no app is needed. But unfortuately, that is NOT the case. It's impossible to tell how long a cycle will take without the app. When a cycle won't run, the display panel just shows a lot of blinking lights - the app is required to identify the problem. An error display, or even an error code would be better (although an error code would need to be documented, and as mentioned above, the documentation is very poor.) This machine would be better if it had no WiFi interface, so that the designers would have been compelled to focus on a meaningful control panel and user's manual. Furthermore, after about a week, the dishwasher failed. The Bosch warranty repair service was backlogged, so we were washing dishes by hand for about 10 days before it was repaired.

Sentence (English): About 2 and a half years in, the water pump went out.
Comments (English): About 2 and a half years in, the water pump went out. After spending a ridiculous amount of time on the phone with Kitchenaid/Whirlpool, I was finally able to schedule service. Because parts are only warrantied up to 12 months, I was charged $356. The local 3rd party technician came out to service, only to tell me that Whirlpool ordered the wrong model of pump for this unit, stating that he would have to return another time after calling Whirlpool to correct the order-which 2 days later still has not happened. A $1200 dishwasher should be expected to last more than 2.5 years before needing service.Additionally, Costco installed this unit and now it is loose and uneven in my counter (I can move it back and forth). Recommend staying away from this model.

Before installation, the kitchen felt a bit empty, but after installation, the dishwasher and induction cooktop were neatly integrated, giving it a much more sophisticated feel. The residual heat indicator ensures safety, making it a safe choice for families with children. The clean design adds a sophisticated touch to the kitchen, and the built-in installation optimizes space utilization. I personally find it incredibly convenient to use one of the three-burner induction cooktops for boiling water and the other two for cooking. Especially when you take advantage of the top-rated energy efficiency rating and the Premium Efficiency Rebate program, the perceived price is even more reasonable, making it highly satisfying. I'd personally give it a 4.8/5. I've been using it happily in my kitchen every day without any major issues.
