Sentence (English): A solid three star – dishwasher.
Comments (English): A solid three star – dishwasher. I'll give it four stars because it just makes sense.For me, the pricing with installation was within my budget. It is cleaning and disinfecting things just fine. My only gripe is that there is often quite a bit of moisture left in the machine after the cycle is finished. I really don't care though-because I have a dishwasher now. After two years without one, you realize the big picture is you have something that cleans all of your dishes and empties out your sink. If you want to get in and out for under $700 with everything included, that means delivery, removal of old appliance, and installation of new appliance – this is the way to go. I don't think you'll find much cheaper. It gets the job done and that's all that matters. It's actually not that loud. I also went with white. I have stainless steel every place else, but with white cabinets, it actually looks pretty good. I'm just so glad to not have to hand wash things anymore. Let's face it dishwashers save time. Was it the fanciest? No way. Was it worth it? Absolutely.

Sentence (English): I like this dishwasher!
Comments (English): [ It's nearly perfect ] || ---------------- || I like this dishwasher! It works very well to clean and dry the dishes. I love that the door can automatically crack open to assist with further drying after the dry cycle. Took one star off because mine came with a big dent inside, way in the back. I have to push the bottom drawer a little harder but I thought that was because it was new. I LOVE the third shelf. I didn't think I was going to use it but it's perfect for straws, water bottle tops and other small items. I like that on the utensil basket you can chose to use the piece that lets you put one utensil in each little slot or flip it up to use it as a normal basket. I hate the slotted utensil part but I'm sure other people use it so it's nice to have that option. It's not overly complicated to run which is also great. Simple and straightforward buttons. It's very quiet! Overall great product but be sure to thoroughly inspect the entire inside of the wash basin, it's easy to miss dents since it's so shiny!

App integration for cleaning schedules and diagnostics enhances user convenience, and its sleek design complements any kitchen interior. This product makes you realize that it is not just a machine that does the dishes for you, but a home appliance that improves your quality of life.
Comments (Original): LG 식기세척기는 강력한 세척력과 위생 관리 기능이 돋보이는 제품입니다. 다수의 노즐과 고압수를 활용해 식기 구석구석까지 세척해주기 때문에 기름기 많은 냄비나 접시도 깔끔하게 세정됩니다. 특히 트루스팀(TrueSteam) 기능을 통해 고온의 스팀이 식기에 닿아 세균을 제거하고 물자국을 최소화해 위생적이면서도 맑고 투명한 마무리를 제공합니다. 내부 공간이 넓고 3단 조절이 가능해 다양한 크기의 식기를 유연하게 적재할 수 있어, 대가족이나 손님 접대 후에도 한 번에 많은 식기를 처리할 수 있습니다. 세척 모드는 표준, 강력, 에코, 자동 등 상황에 맞게 선택할 수 있고, 자동 모드의 경우 오염 정도를 감지해 물과 전력을 효율적으로 사용하니 관리 비용도 절감됩니다. 소음 수준이 낮아 밤에 가동해도 생활에 방해되지 않고, 세척 후 자동 문 열림 기능으로 내부 습기가 빠져 건조력도 탁월합니다. 앱 연동을 통해 세척 예약이나 진단도 가능해 사용 편의성이 높고, 세련된 디자인 덕분에 주방에 설치했을 때 인테리어적으로도 잘 어울립니다. 단순히 설거지를 대신해주는 기계가 아니라 생활의 질을 높여주는 가전임을 실감하게 해주는 제품입니다.

Comments (English): I had a MyDeal dishwasher, 12-seater, ivory, MDWEF1233G(A)-KR, installed on-site. The dishwasher I purchased in 2021 worked well, but the power supply broke, and I was worried it would cost over 200,000 won. So I searched Coupang and saw that prices had dropped significantly, but all the models were built-in. I needed a freestanding dishwasher, so I was hesitant. After living without a dishwasher for about a month, it was very inconvenient. Then I saw the MyDeal dishwasher. The model below it was a bit cheaper, but I hesitated to buy it. This time, the Gold Box deal came up, so I bought it. I actually postponed the installation date for a while to research more, but I finally made up my mind and submitted the installation request. The installer contacted me that morning. He said 2-4 PM, but he arrived around 2 PM. It was a tricky installation, so it took longer than expected. I used to use the dishwasher well, so I didn't think it would be a big problem, but there were quite a few tricky issues. Still, I managed to resolve them one by one. The wall-mounted faucet leaves some open areas, which makes it look a bit messy, but that was unavoidable. Drilling costs almost came up, but they didn't. Since it's freestanding, the top is clean. It's connected to a mobile phone, so you can manage it from there. All you need is Wi-Fi. It's also connected to a water purifier, which is quite interesting. It's a bit strange to see the water flowing in small streams, but it washes dishes well. After installation, turn it on, select the desired cycle, and press the start button. Opening and closing is as simple as opening and closing. However, it doesn't open while running. SK dishwashers have short cycles that are convenient because they last around 20 minutes, but the media cycle is the shortest at 1 hour and 20 minutes. There's a rinse-dry option, but it's a rinse-and-dry option, meaning it doesn't use detergent, so it only rinses and dries. There are also heavy-duty and night cycles, so I think I'll use them a lot. I was worried because it was a lot cheaper than I expected, but it's better than I thought. The dishes come out clean, too. It's as clean as new, and the opening and closing feel is smooth and nice. I didn't get insurance, but there's a two-year warranty, so I hope it doesn't break down and I can use it well. I chose ivory instead of white, but these days, I think colored products look better than white. I really like the slightly beige feel. It's a light ivory, but I like it. It feels soft.

I quickly checked my order again, and sure enough, I'd ordered the wrong dishwasher for my dishwasher height. So, I canceled the order and spent a few days searching again, until this one caught my eye. [Pros] 1. The dishwasher lights up inside. I couldn't ignore this feature. As a handyman, I often run my dishwasher late at night, so I was always worried about the noise level bothering my neighbors or the downstairs neighbors. Sometimes, I laugh because it feels like I'm always playing Tetris while using the dishwasher. 4. Just put the dishes in, press a button, and it'll clean them squeakily. My family can spend that time playing their favorite games or focusing more on parenting! 2. Small but powerful, perfect for my kitchen! : I love how compact it is, and it doesn't take up much kitchen space! Since it's designed for three people, it's perfect for a single person or a small family like my family who just needs to wash dishes after meals. 3. Really hygienic and clean! : It uses hot water and a strong detergent to remove stubborn stains, making it much more hygienic than hand washing. It's especially reassuring when sterilizing things like baby dishes! 4. No more dishes piling up in the sink! : Don't you sigh and stress when you see a pile of dishes after a meal? Now that the dishwasher does it all, your sink will always be neat and clean, and your kitchen will look pristine. 5. Installation will be easier than you think! : Since it's a mini dishwasher, there are many models that are simple to use without complicated plumbing installation! You'll be able to do the basics by yourself in no time. 6. This smart kid saves water too! : Dishwashers use less water than you think when you wash dishes by hand! It's a great product because it's environmentally friendly and saves on your water bill! 7. It's a PRO model, so it'll have a pretty design! : Seeing that it has "PRO" in it, I think the design will be neater and more sophisticated. It'll match your kitchen interior well, so you'll feel even better! 8. It even has a drying function, so you can use it right away! : It's so convenient because you don't have to dry the dripping dishes after washing them. They're dried fluffy and ready to be used right away! 9. It also reduces food odors! : The dishwasher washes and dries your dishes cleanly and odorlessly, so your kitchen will always feel refreshed because there will be less food odor. 10. You'll be happier after eating! : Mealtimes will be more enjoyable and satisfying because after a delicious meal, you can just throw the dishes in the dishwasher without worrying about washing them! Your whole family will be happy!
Comments (Original): 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.  1.  이제 설거지에서 해방이야!: 힘들게 손으로 기름때 벅벅 문지를 필요 없어! 그냥 그릇 넣고 버튼만 누르면 뽀득뽀득 깨끗하게 닦아주니까, 우리 기초는 그 시간에 좋아하는 게임을 하거나, 육아에 더 집중할 수 있을 거야! 2.  작지만 알차서 우리 집 주방에 딱이야!: 미니 사이즈라서 주방 공간을 많이 차지하지 않아서 너무 좋아! 3인용이라 혼자 살거나, 우리 기초네 가족처럼 딱 적은 인원이 식사하고 설거지할 때 딱이겠지? 3.  진짜 위생적이고 깨끗하게 닦아줘!: 뜨거운 물이랑 강력한 세제로 찌든 때까지 싹 지워주니까 손설거지보다 훨씬 위생적이야. 특히 아기들 식기 같은 거 소독할 때 진짜 안심될 걸! 4.  싱크대에 그릇 쌓일 일이 없어!: 밥 먹고 나서 설거지 쌓여 있으면 괜히 한숨 나오고 스트레스 받잖아? 이제 식기세척기가 다 해주니까 싱크대가 늘 깔끔하고 주방도 깨끗해 보일 거야. 5.  설치도 생각보다 간단할 걸?: 미니 식기세척기라서 복잡하게 배관 설치할 필요 없이 그냥 간편하게 쓸 수 있는 모델도 많대! 우리 기초도 혼자 척척 할 수 있을 거야. 6.  물도 아껴주는 똑똑한 아이야!: 생각보다 손설거지보다 식기세척기가 물을 덜 쓴대! 환경도 생각하고 우리 집 수도세도 아껴주니까 완전 효자 상품이지! 7.  PRO 모델이라 디자인도 예쁠 거야!: 'PRO'라고 붙은 거 보면 뭔가 디자인도 더 깔끔하고 세련되게 나왔을 것 같아. 주방 인테리어랑도 잘 어울려서 더 기분 좋을 거야! 8.  건조 기능까지 있어서 바로 사용할 수 있어!: 설거지 다 하고 나서 물기 뚝뚝 떨어지는 그릇 말릴 필요 없이, 건조까지 뽀송하게 해주니까 바로 식기에 넣거나 사용할 수 있어서 너무 편리해! 9.  음식물 냄새 걱정도 덜어줘!: 식기세척기가 냄새 없이 깨끗하게 그릇을 세척하고 건조해주니까 주방에 음식물 냄새가 덜해서 늘 상쾌한 기분이 들 거야. 10. 밥 먹고 나서 더 행복할 수 있어!: 맛있는 밥 먹고 나서 설거지 걱정 없이 그냥 식기세척기에 넣기만 하면 되니까 식사 시간이 더 즐겁고 행복해질 거야! 우리 가족 모두가 만족할 걸!

The dishwasher holds less dishes than my old dishwasher because of the rack configuration so that's the reason I would give this dishwasher a four out of five although it's really an almost a five star. The Kitchenaid has several wash cycles to choose from - as many as much more expensive dishwashers. The white dishwasher matches my white cupboards but the stainless steel handle is really a nice contrast and ties in the appliance to my stainless steel fridge. As many newer dishwashers do, it seems to take a much longer time to complete its cycles than my old dishwasher but n not really a problem. Only had it a short time so hoping it continues to work so well.

Sentence (English): I had a visit to install a MyDeal dishwasher, 12-person, ivory, MDWEF1233G(A)-KR, which I bought with my own money.
Comments (English): I had a visit to install a MyDeal dishwasher, 12-person, ivory, MDWEF1233G(A)-KR, which I bought with my own money. I used the dishwasher I bought in 2021 without any problems, but this time, the power supply part broke, so I was worried that it would cost over 200,000 won. So I searched on Coupang and saw that the price had dropped a lot compared to before, but they were all built-in. I was worried because I needed a freestanding one, but after living without a dishwasher for about a month, it was very uncomfortable. Then I saw a MyDeal dishwasher. The model below was a lot cheaper, but I didn't buy it after much thought. This time, I bought it because the Gold Box deal was up. I actually postponed the installation date for a while to find out more, but I finally did. I finally made up my mind and applied for installation. The installer contacted me that morning. He said 2-4 PM, but he arrived around 2 PM. It was a tricky installation, so it took longer than I expected. I used the dishwasher before, so I didn't think it would be a big deal, but there were quite a few tricky issues. Still, I was able to resolve them one by one. The wall-mounted faucet has some open areas, so it looks a bit messy, but it couldn't be helped. I almost had to pay for drilling, but it didn't. Since it's freestanding, the top is clean. Sentence (English): I bought it with my own money.
Comments (English): I bought it with my own money. I had a MyDeer dishwasher, 12-seater, ivory, MDWEF1233G(A)-KR, installed on-site. The dishwasher I bought in 2021 worked fine, but this time, the power supply broke, and I was worried it would cost over 200,000 won. So I searched Coupang and saw that prices had dropped significantly, but they were all built-in. I needed a freestanding dishwasher, so I was considering it, but after living without one for about a month, it was very inconvenient. Then I saw the MyDeer dishwasher. The model below it was a bit cheaper, but I hesitated and decided not to buy it. This time, the Gold Box deal came up, so I bought it. I actually postponed the installation date for a while to research more, but I finally made up my mind and submitted the installation request. The installer contacted me that morning. He said 2-4 PM, but he arrived around 2 PM. It was a tricky installation, so it took longer than expected. I used to use the dishwasher well, so I didn't think it would be a big problem, but there were quite a few tricky issues. Still, I managed to resolve them one by one. The wall-mounted faucet leaves some open areas, which makes it look a bit messy, but that was unavoidable. Drilling costs almost came up, but they didn't. Since it's freestanding, the top is clean. It's connected to a mobile phone, so you can manage it from there. All you need is Wi-Fi. It's also connected to a water purifier line, which is quite interesting. It's a bit strange to see the water flowing in small streams, but it washes dishes well. After installing everything, turn it on, select the desired cycle, and then press the start button. Opening and closing is as simple as opening and closing. However, it doesn't open while running. SK dishwashers have short cycles that are usually around 20 minutes, which is convenient, but the media cycle is the shortest at 1 hour and 20 minutes. There's a rinse-dry mode, but it's literally a rinse-and-dry mode, so no detergent is added, so it only rinses and dries. There are also intensive and night cycles, so I think I'll be able to use them well. I was worried because it was cheaper than I expected, but it's better than I thought. The dishes are also clean. As it's new, it's very clean, and the opening and closing feel is smooth and nice. I didn't get insurance, but there's a two-year free warranty, so I hope it doesn't break down and I can use it well. Sentence (English): Purchased with my own money.
Comments (English): Purchased with my own money. I purchased the My Dear 12-place setting dishwasher in Ivory, MDWEF1233G(A)-KR, and had it installed by a professional. I had been using the dishwasher I bought in 2021 quite well, but this time the power part broke, and I was hesitant because the repair cost was expected to exceed 200,000 won. So I searched on Coupang and saw that prices had dropped significantly compared to before, but they were all built-in models. I needed a freestanding one, so I hesitated, and living without a dishwasher for about a month was very inconvenient. Then I came across the My Dear dishwasher. The model below this one was much cheaper, but I hesitated and didn't buy it. This time, a Gold Box deal popped up again, so I made the purchase. Actually, I had postponed the installation date quite a while to do more research before finally getting it installed. I made up my mind again and requested the installation. I received a call from the technician on the morning of the day. They said it would be between 2 PM and 4 PM, but they arrived around 2 PM. It took longer than expected because it was a somewhat tricky installation. Since I had used my previous dishwasher well, I didn't think it would be much of a problem, but there were actually quite a few tricky issues. Still, I managed to resolve everything one by one. Since it is a wall-mounted unit, there are some exposed areas that look a bit messy, but it was unavoidable. I almost had to pay for drilling, but I didn't. As it is a freestanding unit, the top surface is very neat. It connects to a mobile phone, so you can manage it via your phone; you just need to connect to Wi-Fi. It is quite fascinating that it connects to the water purifier line. It is a bit strange to see the water enter in such a small stream, but it washes dishes well. After installation, turn on the power, select the course you want, and then press the start button. You just open and close it normally. However, it does not open while the unit is running. The SK dishwasher was convenient because most of the short courses were around 20 minutes, but the Midea's shortest course is 1 hour and 20 minutes. There is a rinse-dry function, but since it is literally just rinse-drying without detergent, it only performs rinse-drying. There are also powerful and night courses, so I think I will use it well. I was worried because it was much cheaper than I expected, but it is better than I thought. The dishes come out clean, too. As it is new, it is very clean, and the opening and closing feel is smooth and nice. I didn't get insurance, but since it comes with a 2-year warranty, I hope it doesn't break down and I can use it well. I chose ivory instead of white, and I think colored products like this look prettier than white ones these days. I really like the subtle beige vibe. It's a light ivory, but I like it in its own way. It feels soft. The downside? The touch screen is right on the front, so I end up accidentally touching it. Usually, the touch switch is on the top, but since the Midea dishwasher is right on the front, I keep touching it and it keeps turning on. Also, I wish there was a short cycle; the shortest time is about 70 minutes, so that's a bit disappointing. There are times when I do miss the SK Quick cycle a little. Still, it is much sturdier and better made, and easier to use, so the advantages far outweigh the disadvantages. Quite a bit of time has passed already—it’s been six months. I still only use the standard cycle. I use it twice a day, sometimes up to four times. It's good. It works well, and I also like that it syncs with my phone to notify me.

Actually, I had postponed the installation date quite a while to do more research before finally getting it installed. I made up my mind again and requested the installation. I received a call from the technician on the morning of the day. They said it would be between 2 PM and 4 PM, but they arrived around 2 PM. It took longer than expected because it was a somewhat tricky installation. Since I had used my previous dishwasher well, I didn't think it would be much of a problem, but there were actually quite a few tricky issues. Still, I managed to resolve everything one by one. Since it is a wall-mounted unit, there are some exposed areas that look a bit messy, but it was unavoidable. I almost had to pay for drilling, but I didn't. As it is a freestanding unit, the top surface is very neat. It connects to a mobile phone, so you can manage it via your phone; you just need to connect to Wi-Fi. It is quite fascinating that it connects to the water purifier line. It is a bit strange to see the water enter in such a small stream, but it washes dishes well. After installation, turn on the power, select the course you want, and then press the start button. You just open and close it normally. However, it does not open while the unit is running. The SK dishwasher was convenient because most of the short courses were around 20 minutes, but the Midea's shortest course is 1 hour and 20 minutes. There is a rinse-dry function, but since it is literally just rinse-drying without detergent, it only performs rinse-drying. There are also powerful and night courses, so I think I will use it well. I was worried because it was much cheaper than I expected, but it is better than I thought. The dishes come out clean, too. As it is new, it is very clean, and the opening and closing feel is smooth and nice. I didn't get insurance, but since it comes with a 2-year warranty, I hope it doesn't break down and I can use it well. I chose ivory instead of white, and I think colored products like this look prettier than white ones these days. I really like the subtle beige vibe. It's a light ivory, but I like it in its own way. It feels soft. The downside? The touch screen is right on the front, so I end up accidentally touching it. Usually, the touch switch is on the top, but since the Midea dishwasher is right on the front, I keep touching it and it keeps turning on. Also, I wish there was a short cycle; the shortest time is about 70 minutes, so that's a bit disappointing. There are times when I do miss the SK Quick cycle a little. Still, it is much sturdier and better made, and easier to use, so the advantages far outweigh the disadvantages. Quite a bit of time has passed already—it’s been six months. I still only use the standard cycle. I use it twice a day, sometimes up to four times. It's good. It works well, and I also like that it syncs with my phone to notify me.

Sentence (English): Then I came across the My Dear dishwasher.

Still, it is much sturdier and better made, and easier to use, so the advantages far outweigh the disadvantages. Quite a bit of time has passed already—it’s been six months. Sentence (English): I made up my mind again and requested the installation.
Comments (English): Purchased with my own money. I purchased the My Dear 12-place setting dishwasher in Ivory, MDWEF1233G(A)-KR, and had it installed by a professional. I had been using the dishwasher I bought in 2021 quite well, but this time the power part broke, and I was hesitant because the repair cost was expected to exceed 200,000 won. So I searched on Coupang and saw that prices had dropped significantly compared to before, but they were all built-in models. I needed a freestanding one, so I hesitated, and living without a dishwasher for about a month was very inconvenient. Then I came across the My Dear dishwasher. The model below this one was much cheaper, but I hesitated and didn't buy it. This time, a Gold Box deal popped up again, so I made the purchase. Actually, I had postponed the installation date quite a while to do more research before finally getting it installed. I made up my mind again and requested the installation. I received a call from the technician on the morning of the day. They said it would be between 2 PM and 4 PM, but they arrived around 2 PM. It took longer than expected because it was a somewhat tricky installation. Since I had used my previous dishwasher well, I didn't think it would be much of a problem, but there were actually quite a few tricky issues. Still, I managed to resolve everything one by one. Since it is a wall-mounted unit, there are some exposed areas that look a bit messy, but it was unavoidable. I almost had to pay for drilling, but I didn't. As it is a freestanding unit, the top surface is very neat. It connects to a mobile phone, so you can manage it via your phone; you just need to connect to Wi-Fi. It is quite fascinating that it connects to the water purifier line. It is a bit strange to see the water enter in such a small stream, but it washes dishes well. After installation, turn on the power, select the course you want, and then press the start button. You just open and close it normally. However, it does not open while the unit is running. The SK dishwasher was convenient because most of the short courses were around 20 minutes, but the Midea's shortest course is 1 hour and 20 minutes. There is a rinse-dry function, but since it is literally just rinse-drying without detergent, it only performs rinse-drying. There are also powerful and night courses, so I think I will use it well. I was worried because it was much cheaper than I expected, but it is better than I thought. The dishes come out clean, too. As it is new, it is very clean, and the opening and closing feel is smooth and nice. I didn't get insurance, but since it comes with a 2-year warranty, I hope it doesn't break down and I can use it well. I chose ivory instead of white, and I think colored products like this look prettier than white ones these days. I really like the subtle beige vibe. It's a light ivory, but I like it in its own way. It feels soft. The downside? The touch screen is right on the front, so I end up accidentally touching it. Usually, the touch switch is on the top, but since the Midea dishwasher is right on the front, I keep touching it and it keeps turning on. Also, I wish there was a short cycle; the shortest time is about 70 minutes, so that's a bit disappointing. There are times when I do miss the SK Quick cycle a little. Still, it is much sturdier and better made, and easier to use, so the advantages far outweigh the disadvantages. Quite a bit of time has passed already—it’s been six months. I still only use the standard cycle. I use it twice a day, sometimes up to four times. It's good. It works well, and I also like that it syncs with my phone to notify me.

Sentence (English): Since I had used my previous dishwasher well, I didn't think it would be much of a problem, but there were actually quite a few tricky issues.
Comments (English): Purchased with my own money. I purchased the My Dear 12-place setting dishwasher in Ivory, MDWEF1233G(A)-KR, and had it installed by a professional. So I searched on Coupang and saw that prices had dropped significantly compared to before, but they were all built-in models. I needed a freestanding one, so I hesitated, and living without a dishwasher for about a month was very inconvenient. Then I came across the My Dear dishwasher. The model below this one was much cheaper, but I hesitated and didn't buy it. This time, a Gold Box deal popped up again, so I made the purchase. Actually, I had postponed the installation date quite a while to do more research before finally getting it installed. I made up my mind again and requested the installation. I received a call from the technician on the morning of the day. They said it would be between 2 PM and 4 PM, but they arrived around 2 PM. It took longer than expected because it was a somewhat tricky installation. Since I had used my previous dishwasher well, I didn't think it would be much of a problem, but there were actually quite a few tricky issues. Still, I managed to resolve everything one by one. Since it is a wall-mounted unit, there are some exposed areas that look a bit messy, but it was unavoidable. I almost had to pay for drilling, but I didn't. As it is a freestanding unit, the top surface is very neat. It connects to a mobile phone, so you can manage it via your phone; you just need to connect to Wi-Fi. After installation, turn on the power, select the course you want, and then press the start button. You just open and close it normally. However, it does not open while the unit is running. The SK dishwasher was convenient because most of the short courses were around 20 minutes, but the Midea's shortest course is 1 hour and 20 minutes. There is a rinse-dry function, but since it is literally just rinse-drying without detergent, it only performs rinse-drying. There are also powerful and night courses, so I think I will use it well. I was worried because it was much cheaper than I expected, but it is better than I thought. The dishes come out clean, too. As it is new, it is very clean, and the opening and closing feel is smooth and nice. I didn't get insurance, but since it comes with a 2-year warranty, I hope it doesn't break down and I can use it well. I chose ivory instead of white, and I think colored products like this look prettier than white ones these days. I really like the subtle beige vibe. It's a light ivory, but I like it in its own way. It feels soft. The downside? The touch screen is right on the front, so I end up accidentally touching it. Usually, the touch switch is on the top, but since the Midea dishwasher is right on the front, I keep touching it and it keeps turning on. Also, I wish there was a short cycle; the shortest time is about 70 minutes, so that's a bit disappointing. There are times when I do miss the SK Quick cycle a little. Still, it is much sturdier and better made, and easier to use, so the advantages far outweigh the disadvantages. Quite a bit of time has passed already—it’s been six months. I still only use the standard cycle. I use it twice a day, sometimes up to four times. It's good. It works well, and I also like that it syncs with my phone to notify me.

Sentence (English): I was worried because it was much cheaper than I expected, but it is better than I thought.
Comments (English): Purchased with my own money. I purchased the My Dear 12-place setting dishwasher in Ivory, MDWEF1233G(A)-KR, and had it installed by a professional. I had been using the dishwasher I bought in 2021 quite well, but this time the power part broke, and I was hesitant because the repair cost was expected to exceed 200,000 won. So I searched on Coupang and saw that prices had dropped significantly compared to before, but they were all built-in models. I needed a freestanding one, so I hesitated, and living without a dishwasher for about a month was very inconvenient. Then I came across the My Dear dishwasher. The model below this one was much cheaper, but I hesitated and didn't buy it. This time, a Gold Box deal popped up again, so I made the purchase. Actually, I had postponed the installation date quite a while to do more research before finally getting it installed. I made up my mind again and requested the installation. I received a call from the technician on the morning of the day. They said it would be between 2 PM and 4 PM, but they arrived around 2 PM. It took longer than expected because it was a somewhat tricky installation. Since I had used my previous dishwasher well, I didn't think it would be much of a problem, but there were actually quite a few tricky issues. Still, I managed to resolve everything one by one. Since it is a wall-mounted unit, there are some exposed areas that look a bit messy, but it was unavoidable. I almost had to pay for drilling, but I didn't. As it is a freestanding unit, the top surface is very neat. It connects to a mobile phone, so you can manage it via your phone; you just need to connect to Wi-Fi. After installation, turn on the power, select the course you want, and then press the start button. You just open and close it normally. However, it does not open while the unit is running. The SK dishwasher was convenient because most of the short courses were around 20 minutes, but the Midea's shortest course is 1 hour and 20 minutes. There is a rinse-dry function, but since it is literally just rinse-drying without detergent, it only performs rinse-drying. There are also powerful and night courses, so I think I will use it well. I was worried because it was much cheaper than I expected, but it is better than I thought. The dishes come out clean, too. As it is new, it is very clean, and the opening and closing feel is smooth and nice. I didn't get insurance, but since it comes with a 2-year warranty, I hope it doesn't break down and I can use it well. I chose ivory instead of white, and I think colored products like this look prettier than white ones these days. I really like the subtle beige vibe. It's a light ivory, but I like it in its own way. It feels soft. The downside? The touch screen is right on the front, so I end up accidentally touching it. Usually, the touch switch is on the top, but since the Midea dishwasher is right on the front, I keep touching it and it keeps turning on. Also, I wish there was a short cycle; the shortest time is about 70 minutes, so that's a bit disappointing. There are times when I do miss the SK Quick cycle a little. Still, it is much sturdier and better made, and easier to use, so the advantages far outweigh the disadvantages. Quite a bit of time has passed already—it’s been six months. I still only use the standard cycle. I use it twice a day, sometimes up to four times. It's good. It works well, and I also like that it syncs with my phone to notify me.

Comments (English): Purchased with my own money. I purchased the My Dear 12-place setting dishwasher in Ivory, MDWEF1233G(A)-KR, and had it installed by a professional. I had been using the dishwasher I bought in 2021 quite well, but this time the power part broke, and I was hesitant because the repair cost was expected to exceed 200,000 won. So I searched on Coupang and saw that prices had dropped significantly compared to before, but they were all built-in models. I needed a freestanding one, so I hesitated, and living without a dishwasher for about a month was very inconvenient. Then I came across the My Dear dishwasher. The model below this one was much cheaper, but I hesitated and didn't buy it. This time, a Gold Box deal popped up again, so I made the purchase. Actually, I had postponed the installation date quite a while to do more research before finally getting it installed. I made up my mind again and requested the installation. I received a call from the technician on the morning of the day. They said it would be between 2 PM and 4 PM, but they arrived around 2 PM. It took longer than expected because it was a somewhat tricky installation. Since I had used my previous dishwasher well, I didn't think it would be much of a problem, but there were actually quite a few tricky issues. Still, I managed to resolve everything one by one. Since it is a wall-mounted unit, there are some exposed areas that look a bit messy, but it was unavoidable. I almost had to pay for drilling, but I didn't. As it is a freestanding unit, the top surface is very neat. It connects to a mobile phone, so you can manage it via your phone; you just need to connect to Wi-Fi. It is quite fascinating that it connects to the water purifier line. It is a bit strange to see the water enter in such a small stream, but it washes dishes well. After installation, turn on the power, select the course you want, and then press the start button. You just open and close it normally. However, it does not open while the unit is running. The SK dishwasher was convenient because most of the short courses were around 20 minutes, but the Midea's shortest course is 1 hour and 20 minutes. There is a rinse-dry function, but since it is literally just rinse-drying without detergent, it only performs rinse-drying. There are also powerful and night courses, so I think I will use it well. I was worried because it was much cheaper than I expected, but it is better than I thought. The dishes come out clean, too. As it is new, it is very clean, and the opening and closing feel is smooth and nice. I didn't get insurance, but since it comes with a 2-year warranty, I hope it doesn't break down and I can use it well. I chose ivory instead of white, and I think colored products like this look prettier than white ones these days. I really like the subtle beige vibe. It's a light ivory, but I like it in its own way. It feels soft. The downside? The touch screen is right on the front, so I end up accidentally touching it. Usually, the touch switch is on the top, but since the Midea dishwasher is right on the front, I keep touching it and it keeps turning on. Also, I wish there was a short cycle; the shortest time is about 70 minutes, so that's a bit disappointing. There are times when I do miss the SK Quick cycle a little. Still, it is much sturdier and better made, and easier to use, so the advantages far outweigh the disadvantages. Quite a bit of time has passed already—it’s been six months. I still only use the standard cycle. I use it twice a day, sometimes up to four times. It's good. It works well, and I also like that it syncs with my phone to notify me.

Sentence (English): Since using the Samsung 6-person dishwasher, I've felt a huge reduction in the stress of washing dishes.
Comments (English): [ I thought about it for a year before buying it. There's no need to think about this! ] || ---------------- || Since using the Samsung 6-person dishwasher, I've felt a huge reduction in the stress of washing dishes. I used to be constantly tired of having to wash dishes multiple times a day, but now I can just put them away and the machine automatically washes them for me. It's truly a transformational experience. When I used to wash dishes by hand, grease and old stains would be difficult to remove, requiring repeated scrubbing. This dishwasher uses hot water to break down grease and thoroughly cleans every crevice, leaving dishes sparkling clean. I was initially worried it might be too small for a 6-person dishwasher, but after using it for a while, I found it to be more than adequate for a small household. It's capable of washing dishes for one or two meals a day in one go, and it can easily accommodate cups, rice bowls, and side dish dishes. However, it can be a bit overwhelming to fit large pots and pans in one go, so it requires some thoughtful planning. Still, it's ample space for frequently used dishes, so it's not a major inconvenience. I especially appreciated the automatic door opening after each wash, allowing moisture to escape and air-dry. I used to worry about water droplets or odors after washing, but now that the door opens for ventilation, dishes dry much more smoothly. The stainless steel interior is hygienic and reduces water stains and odors, which I also appreciate. The clean design blends well with the kitchen's interior. One drawback is that the standard wash cycle takes longer than expected. It typically takes over an hour, which can be a bit inconvenient when you need to wash dishes in a hurry. However, considering the cleaning power and drying performance, I think that's worth it. It can sometimes be difficult to load large utensils at once, but that's a natural consideration given the capacity. Overall, I highly recommend the Samsung 6-person dishwasher to small families, dual-income couples, and families with children who have a large daily dishwashing load and want to save time. The reduced dishwashing time and significantly cleaner kitchen have led to a high level of satisfaction. It's a definite improvement in my quality of life, making me wonder, "Why did I wait so long to buy a dishwasher?"

There's no need to think about this! ] || ---------------- || Since using the Samsung 6-person dishwasher, I've felt a huge reduction in the stress of washing dishes. I used to be constantly tired of having to wash dishes multiple times a day, but now I can just put them away and the machine automatically washes them for me. It's truly a transformational experience. When I used to wash dishes by hand, grease and old stains would be difficult to remove, requiring repeated scrubbing. This dishwasher uses hot water to break down grease and thoroughly cleans every crevice, leaving dishes sparkling clean. I was initially worried it might be too small for a 6-person dishwasher, but after using it for a while, I found it to be more than adequate for a small household. It's capable of washing dishes for one or two meals a day in one go, and it can easily accommodate cups, rice bowls, and side dish dishes. However, it can be a bit overwhelming to fit large pots and pans in one go, so it requires some thoughtful planning. Still, it's ample space for frequently used dishes, so it's not a major inconvenience. I especially appreciated the automatic door opening after each wash, allowing moisture to escape and air-dry. I used to worry about water droplets or odors after washing, but now that the door opens for ventilation, dishes dry much more smoothly. The stainless steel interior is hygienic and reduces water stains and odors, which I also appreciate. The clean design blends well with the kitchen's interior. One drawback is that the standard wash cycle takes longer than expected. It typically takes over an hour, which can be a bit inconvenient when you need to wash dishes in a hurry. However, considering the cleaning power and drying performance, I think that's worth it. It can sometimes be difficult to load large utensils at once, but that's a natural consideration given the capacity. Overall, I highly recommend the Samsung 6-person dishwasher to small families, dual-income couples, and families with children who have a large daily dishwashing load and want to save time. The reduced dishwashing time and significantly cleaner kitchen have led to a high level of satisfaction. It's a definite improvement in my quality of life, making me wonder, "Why did I wait so long to buy a dishwasher?"

The stainless steel interior is hygienic and reduces water stains and odors, which I also appreciate. The clean design blends well with the kitchen's interior. It can sometimes be difficult to load large utensils at once, but that's a natural consideration given the capacity. Overall, I highly recommend the Samsung 6-person dishwasher to small families, dual-income couples, and families with children who have a large daily dishwashing load and want to save time. The reduced dishwashing time and significantly cleaner kitchen have led to a high level of satisfaction. It's a definite improvement in my quality of life, making me wonder, "Why did I wait so long to buy a dishwasher?"

Overall, I highly recommend the Samsung 6-person dishwasher to small families, dual-income couples, and families with children who have a large daily dishwashing load and want to save time. It's a definite improvement in my quality of life, making me wonder, "Why did I wait so long to buy a dishwasher?"

I used to be constantly tired of having to wash dishes multiple times a day, but now I can just put them away and the machine automatically washes them for me. This dishwasher uses hot water to break down grease and thoroughly cleans every crevice, leaving dishes sparkling clean. I was initially worried it might be too small for a 6-person dishwasher, but after using it for a while, I found it to be more than adequate for a small household. However, it can be a bit overwhelming to fit large pots and pans in one go, so it requires some thoughtful planning. Still, it's ample space for frequently used dishes, so it's not a major inconvenience. I especially appreciated the automatic door opening after each wash, allowing moisture to escape and air-dry. I used to worry about water droplets or odors after washing, but now that the door opens for ventilation, dishes dry much more smoothly. The stainless steel interior is hygienic and reduces water stains and odors, which I also appreciate. The clean design blends well with the kitchen's interior. One drawback is that the standard wash cycle takes longer than expected. It typically takes over an hour, which can be a bit inconvenient when you need to wash dishes in a hurry. However, considering the cleaning power and drying performance, I think that's worth it. It can sometimes be difficult to load large utensils at once, but that's a natural consideration given the capacity. Overall, I highly recommend the Samsung 6-person dishwasher to small families, dual-income couples, and families with children who have a large daily dishwashing load and want to save time. The reduced dishwashing time and significantly cleaner kitchen have led to a high level of satisfaction. It's a definite improvement in my quality of life, making me wonder, "Why did I wait so long to buy a dishwasher?"

Overall, I highly recommend the Samsung 6-person dishwasher to small families, dual-income couples, and families with children who have a large daily dishwashing load and want to save time. There's no need to think about this! ] || ---------------- || Since using the Samsung 6-person dishwasher, I've felt a huge reduction in the stress of washing dishes. I used to be constantly tired of having to wash dishes multiple times a day, but now I can just put them away and the machine automatically washes them for me. This dishwasher uses hot water to break down grease and thoroughly cleans every crevice, leaving dishes sparkling clean. I was initially worried it might be too small for a 6-person dishwasher, but after using it for a while, I found it to be more than adequate for a small household. It's capable of washing dishes for one or two meals a day in one go, and it can easily accommodate cups, rice bowls, and side dish dishes. However, it can be a bit overwhelming to fit large pots and pans in one go, so it requires some thoughtful planning. Still, it's ample space for frequently used dishes, so it's not a major inconvenience. I especially appreciated the automatic door opening after each wash, allowing moisture to escape and air-dry. I used to worry about water droplets or odors after washing, but now that the door opens for ventilation, dishes dry much more smoothly. The stainless steel interior is hygienic and reduces water stains and odors, which I also appreciate. The clean design blends well with the kitchen's interior. One drawback is that the standard wash cycle takes longer than expected. It typically takes over an hour, which can be a bit inconvenient when you need to wash dishes in a hurry. However, considering the cleaning power and drying performance, I think that's worth it. It can sometimes be difficult to load large utensils at once, but that's a natural consideration given the capacity. Overall, I highly recommend the Samsung 6-person dishwasher to small families, dual-income couples, and families with children who have a large daily dishwashing load and want to save time. The reduced dishwashing time and significantly cleaner kitchen have led to a high level of satisfaction. It's a definite improvement in my quality of life, making me wonder, "Why did I wait so long to buy a dishwasher?"

There's no need to think about this! ] || ---------------- || Since using the Samsung 6-person dishwasher, I've felt a huge reduction in the stress of washing dishes. I used to be constantly tired of having to wash dishes multiple times a day, but now I can just put them away and the machine automatically washes them for me. This dishwasher uses hot water to break down grease and thoroughly cleans every crevice, leaving dishes sparkling clean. It's capable of washing dishes for one or two meals a day in one go, and it can easily accommodate cups, rice bowls, and side dish dishes. However, it can be a bit overwhelming to fit large pots and pans in one go, so it requires some thoughtful planning. Still, it's ample space for frequently used dishes, so it's not a major inconvenience. I especially appreciated the automatic door opening after each wash, allowing moisture to escape and air-dry. I used to worry about water droplets or odors after washing, but now that the door opens for ventilation, dishes dry much more smoothly. The stainless steel interior is hygienic and reduces water stains and odors, which I also appreciate. The clean design blends well with the kitchen's interior. One drawback is that the standard wash cycle takes longer than expected. It typically takes over an hour, which can be a bit inconvenient when you need to wash dishes in a hurry. However, considering the cleaning power and drying performance, I think that's worth it. It can sometimes be difficult to load large utensils at once, but that's a natural consideration given the capacity. Overall, I highly recommend the Samsung 6-person dishwasher to small families, dual-income couples, and families with children who have a large daily dishwashing load and want to save time. It's a definite improvement in my quality of life, making me wonder, "Why did I wait so long to buy a dishwasher?"

Sentence (English): This is my first Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Love the third rack! ] || ---------------- || This is my first Bosch dishwasher. Our old Whirlpool, which cleaned dishes fantastically but was incredibly loud, finally died an honorable death, and I debated and researched several brands and models, and finally succumbed to the Bosch reputation, and paid more accordingly. So far so good! We've had it for several weeks, and its cleaning capability thus far is excellent. It takes way longer than my old model so I am getting used to that, but that is standard for dishwashers now, as I hear. I truly love the third rack, well worth the extra on the price tag. The appearance is very pleasing, and I specifically waited extra weeks on this particular model to be shipped because I wanted the top control, and glad I did. Too tempting for little children to press buttons on the front. I like the adjustable height of middle rack. Still getting used to the idea of not rinsing my dishes before loading. A lifelong habit. I tested one pretty dirty pot without scrubbing first, and while there was no residual clumpy stuck-on food, it did not completely get off a brownish stain that I am sure would have come off had I scrubbed it by hand. But for regular dishes I have no complaints. Overall, I would recommend, 3 weeks into owning it.

Sentence (English): Replaced older Bosch unit that was not drying dishes.
Comments (English): [ Some installation pains ] || ---------------- || Replaced older Bosch unit that was not drying dishes. New unit installed by Walmart and kept giving error after running a while. Walmart installers came back and made sure the hose wasn't kinked and replaced the high loop gadget in our sink. Dishwasher now gave error 6-03, indicating it was not able to push water out. Called plumber to replace hose from high loop to disposal and that didn't help. Then we pulled the hose through the opening to the DW and pushed it back in, which finally curred the problem. So after two weeks we are now able to wash dishes. My wife likes the top silverware drawer. The crystal dry does a good job. Both of us preferred the front controls of the old unit to the new one that is hidden when you close the door. The smart-phone control seems a bit silly. Full user manual was not provided - had to print it out. I found two errors in it that I reported. Manual does a poor job of describing how the dishwasher works.

Sentence (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): [ I recommend it ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. Reason for Purchase: As a Coupang Experience Group member, I received a MINIX PRO Mini Dishwasher in Charcoal Gray for 3 people. I usually hate doing dishes, so I had high expectations for a mini dishwasher, thinking it would be incredibly convenient. The charcoal gray color seemed luxurious and would blend well with my kitchen decor. Most importantly, the no-installation design made it incredibly stress-free. Actual User Review: Upon receiving the product, the packaging was neat, and I was immediately impressed by the sophisticated color. The charcoal gray color has a subtle matte finish, making it less prone to fingerprints and stains. I was expecting it to be no-installation, but it was surprisingly easy to install. Simply plug it in and fill it with water, making setup a breeze even for beginners. The interior features a two-tiered tray design, allowing for organized storage of plates, bowls, cups, and utensils. It also boasts more storage than I expected. It's more than enough for a family of three to wash one meal a day. The dishwashing performance was quite satisfactory. Even greasy dishes were thoroughly cleaned with the high-temperature wash mode, which rinses them with warm water. The sterilization mode also provides added hygiene. It also uses relatively little water, which is a plus. While a bit noisy, it wasn't a major distraction, allowing me to use it even in the evenings. The drying process wasn't completely smooth, and some water marks remained, but that wasn't a major inconvenience. It's perfectly fine to use alongside air drying. I was also pleased with the fact that it doesn't take up much kitchen space and sits neatly in place, making it a no-frills addition to the interior. Summary: Based on my experience with the Coupang Experience Group, the Minix PRO Mini Dishwasher in Charcoal Gray is the perfect size and performance for a three-person household. Sentence (English): I'm writing a review of the MyDear Automatic Door Open UV Lamp Dishwasher, 6-Person, White, MDWMT0601W-WINE-KR.
Comments (English): [ Auntie Dishwasher is better than you think, no-hagong construction! ] || ---------------- || I'm writing a review of the MyDear Automatic Door Open UV Lamp Dishwasher, 6-Person, White, MDWMT0601W-WINE-KR. To sum it up, this is a highly satisfactory product for households with small kitchens, households of two or three, or those looking to reduce dishwashing time. While the capacity is listed as 6-person, it was actually more than enough to wash a family of four or five for a day. It was spacious enough to accommodate bowls, soup bowls, plates, cups, chopsticks, spoons, and even small pots. The efficient interior design allowed me to clean more dishes than I expected with proper storage. It's also compact, making it the perfect fit next to my apartment kitchen sink. I was also very satisfied with the installation. The installer visited my home to perform the installation, but I requested a no-drill installation method because I was hesitant to drill a hole in my sink. The dedicated attachment connects to the faucet, eliminating the need for drilling holes in the sink and leaving no trace, making it convenient for moving later. The drain was also neatly organized, allowing me to use it immediately after installation. The cleaning power and hygiene features exceeded my expectations. The high-temperature wash thoroughly removed grease and food residue, and the door automatically opened after the wash, allowing moisture inside to escape and drying naturally. The UV lamp also activated for a sterilizing effect, virtually eliminating musty odors and water dripping. I especially appreciated the peace of mind that it could be used to wash baby dishes and bottles. The washing cycles were varied, including standard, quick, and intense, allowing me to choose the right one for my needs. Even at night, the noise level was quiet, which didn't bother me. The automatic door opening function was a real plus in my experience. After the wash was complete, the door opened slightly to release hot steam, leaving the inside dry and fresh. The lack of a separate, lengthy drying cycle also helped save energy. The white design blends seamlessly with my kitchen interior. The intuitive controls made it easy for even first-time users to get used to it. The reduction in water usage was also noticeable, significantly reducing water consumption compared to hand washing. I also expect this to save money on electricity and water bills in the long run. One drawback is that, because it's designed for six people, it's difficult to fit large cooking utensils like large pots and pans. Depending on the size of your frequently used utensils, this might be inconvenient. However, if you primarily use basic household utensils, it's more than sufficient. Sentence (English): We've had this about 2 months and we are very happy with how it cleans, how it looks, the racks, low noise, simple controls, and high capacity.
Comments (English): [ Works excellent, looks great, would buy again, see comments on installation ] || ---------------- || We've had this about 2 months and we are very happy with how it cleans, how it looks, the racks, low noise, simple controls, and high capacity. Its capacity is so much higher than, that we now run out of dishes before it is full. We run it using the "auto-sense" cycle where it supposedly senses the angles etc. of the dishes and cleans them appropriately. The great thing is that we don't have to clean our dishes before putting them in the dishwasher :-) 5 stars for its overall performance, assuming you don't install it yourself and because washing dishes is what matters. See my 2-star installation rating below if you plan to install it yourself, you work for Whirlpool, or just curious about build quality.My perspective: I have a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, I've overhauled car engines, built computers from scratch and do all my home repairs. The Whirlpool engineers did not design this for ease of installation and did not consider that their installation process would create a potential breakdown for the end user. None of them attempted to install it themselves in a real home environment with cabinets and etc. Also, I'm guessing that if you pay someone to install this are taking the extra steps I did to compensate for the poor design by *** Engineers. 1. Don't buy the Home Depot cheapie hose and power cord. They are both too short and the power cord doesn't have ringlets on the wires.2. Plan on spending an extra hour because you have to remove the front panel, drain pan, disconnect wiring harnesses, and remove the power junction box to install the POWER CORD (which you have to purchase separately). Supposedly to accommodate some people who will hardwire it instead of plugging it in, but in reality, Whirlpool is cutting costs by not including the cord and using it as an excuse because 99% of people will plug it in to the wall. However, this also creates a QUALITY and RELIABILITY problem. See #2.3. When you install the power cord, the hole in the junction box is too big for the rubber grommet on the power cord (the grommet is meant to hold the power cord in place and also prevent the power cord from shorting out against the metal junction box as the machine vibrates during operation). As such, very little force would be required for the power cord to accidentally pulled too hard and breaking the wiring connections in the junction box. I zip tied the cord on the underside of the dishwasher to prevent it (hopefully) from getting yanked out as I slid the dishwasher into the tight space of the cabinets and wrapped the cord with electrical tape around the grommet. 4. Since the machine does not come with a power cord installed and the Home Depot power cord does not have eyelets on the wires, you can either a) tighten the dishwasher's connector screw onto the bare copper wire or b) attach your own eyelets to the power cord wires for a more permanent attachment. The first option isn't very strong, and the second option is only for 10% of households that have crimping tools and electrical connectors.5. The instructions in the manual are not quite clear when explaining about how much to trim off of the mounting brackets. Do yourself a favor and attach them to the washer and slide the washer to the point you plan to fasten it, then cut the mounting brackets to length.

Even after three meals, you'll have plenty of room to wash the dishes in one go. It's perfect for families. 3. Noise. As a Grade 1 product, I didn't have to worry about my electricity bill, and it seemed to save much water compared to washing dishes by hand. 5. Convenience. I like the multiple wash modes, which allow me to choose based on the amount and level of dirt I have each day. The auto mode, in particular, adjusts the wash time automatically, which I use most often. A few things I'd like to note: The cutlery drawer is a bit cramped, so I have to adjust it when putting in chopsticks or long utensils. Sometimes, the dishwasher doesn't dry perfectly after washing, so leaving the door slightly ajar would have been better. Overall Review: If you're considering a dishwasher, I highly recommend it! Freeing myself from the stress of washing dishes by hand and taking care of hygiene and time has definitely improved my satisfaction. Most importantly, the delivery person's friendly installation made it even more enjoyable.

We personally used the top rack for spatulas, sport bottle lids, scrapers, ect. The new top rack has less height, making less of these items fit. Sentence (English): This is a very good dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Efficient Cleaner ] || ---------------- || This is a very good dishwasher. The major pros that we have enjoyed are the third rack and how adaptable all the racks are. It has handled anything we have put in it all the way up to our largest pan (6 qt). It cleans really well. Per its suggestion we have loaded it up with soiled dishes, think bowls, pots, and pans with baked or dried on rice, oatmeal, and noodles, spoons with peanut butter, knives with jelly, and still it always comes out perfectly clean. Another nice feature is plastic is safe anywhere in the dishwasher (as long as it's dishwasher safe to begin with). There are no exposed heating elements in the dishwasher so plastic is even safe on the bottom rack. The dishes also come out dry as long as there isn't captured water. We would often have to set most of our dishes out to finish drying with our old dishwasher, but dishes go straight to their cabinets after drying in this one. I will even count the app as a pro. It was not a feature I wanted, but it is very easy to navigate, allows for a very customizable wash for your dishes, and allows you to set your dishwasher to clean in the most energy efficient times of day for your schedule. I also appreciate the occasional reminders that it may be time to perform and run a maintenance and cleaning cycle to keep the dishwasher working at top efficiency. Then there are the cons. If I'm being honest, the only cons I can think to mention are that the racks can be a little less than smooth occasionally (not horrendously so) and the top racks clearance from the uppermost sprayer has to be something like .05mm. Since we have switched to this dishwasher I cannot think of a negative experience that would have me warning anyone away from this model. The literal only way it could improve for me would be if it loaded and unloaded itself. I highly recommend this model dishwasher.

Sentence (English): We got this to replace a KitchenAid that only lasted about 4 years.
Comments (English): [ Pretty goog dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We got this to replace a KitchenAid that only lasted about 4 years. Our previous Bosch lasted 10 years, so we're hoping for another 10 out of this one. This unit washes extremely well on the Auto and Heavy cycles - at least as well as the KitchenAid. The Normal cycle struggled a bit to get peanut butter off of the knives in the top rack. The CrystalDry works OK, not quite as well as the KitchenAid ProDry, but better than the old Bosch with no drying at all, and better that typical heat-only drying. The dish racks don't move as smoothly as the KitchenAid's did, and seem kind of cheap for how expensive this model is. The dish racks don't seem to work as well for our randomly assorted dishes (we have young children and lots of random plastic dishes and containers). The KitchenAid did a better job of accomodating odd-sized items.
